sections.title: Classes, Disciplines & Aspects Overview
sections.content:
# Classes, Disciplines & Aspects Overview

<!-- chapter: 04-characters-in-depth | pages: 54-55 -->

Classes Overview
Classes are character archetypes that exist to guide players into developing their
characters. They are often centred around a specific mechanic or type of
equipment, providing a core goal for progression while also laying out potential
directions to branch off into. Classes are your core, but they do not limit you in any
way besides providing you with some unique abilities. Your class also ranks up
passively with your tier, starting at rank 0 in tier 1 and increasing by 1 each time
your tier does up to a maximum of rank 4. This will give you access to new class
features and may be relevant for some abilities.
Class Feature
Class Feature consists of one or multiple passive and active abilities that make it
unique. They may be available right away or unlocked upon reaching a higher Class
rank.
Paths
Once a character reaches Tier 3, they gain the option to settle into one of multiple
available “subclasses” - paths that their character can do down. They differ in
available abilities and serve as both an important mechanical and roleplay decision.
Paths serve as a continuation of class progression, their abilities being unlocked the
same way as class abilities. In order to adopt a specific path, it may be required for
the character to do something in the game to reach the point where that path
seems natural to follow.
Choosing a Class
If you are unsure which class would be best suited for your new character or you
simply want a summary of all classes, refer to the class archetype list in chapter 5.
They represent thematic groupings of classes that should hopefully give you the
idea of what kind of characters would be better suited for which classes.

Disciplines Overview
Disciplines are collections of abilities gathered around a singular theme or style of
combat. Once chosen through advancements, their abilities can be picked up at any
time through advancements or by other means like training or studying. When a
new discipline is chosen, the character may learn up to two of its rank 0 abilities for
free. Disciplines are there to provide players with a flexible character progression
system that lets them create unique builds within classes for their characters,
allowing them a great degree of customization. Every character gains a choice of a
single discipline at creation. Disciplines are covered in depth in chapter 6.
Aspects Overview
Aspects are thoughts and internalized behaviors of characters which can alter the
ways they interact with the environment, mostly in out of combat scenarios. They
may provide alternative ways to deal with specific problems, adjust the costs of
performing specific actions or present ways to gamble on possible outcomes of
events. They are a modular way to make characters unique and provide niche
gameplay alterations that will further specialize them. Aspects are covered in depth
in chapter 7.

sections.title: Character Creation
sections.content:
# Character Creation

<!-- chapter: 04-characters-in-depth | pages: 55-55 -->

Having an overview of all the elements of a character, we can finally discuss how to
actually make one. The full process in its entirety, once you know which level you
are starting at, involves in order:
● Coming up with the basics like the name and character concept
● Choosing an origin
● Picking possible special skills
● Assigning your attribute and skill points
● Picking a class
● Spending advancements
● Picking your discipline(s) and the abilities gained from them
● Picking your convictions
● Picking your aspect(s) if you want to
● Discussing stating equipment with your Narrator

sections.title: Class Archetypes
sections.content:
# Class Archetypes

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 56-57 -->

CH V. Classes
This chapter covers all available class options as well as what exactly they provide in
terms of gameplay. All classes are introduced through three in universe
perspectives which showcase what a character of this class might grapple with
throughout a campaign. After that, the general gameplay loop is explained and all of
the class’ feature abilities are listed alongside recommendations (which do not have
to be followed) for a conventional build.
Class Archetypes
In order to further help you pick out a class, this archetype list should hopefully
illustrate the broad strokes of each of them. Feel free to skip over classes that do
not interest you here while delving deeper into those that intrigue you. Also keep in
mind that the class is not the all-defining feature of your character and that
disciplines and aspects can greatly warp how your character interacts with the
world. Characters with the same class could end up vastly different depending on
those other choices, so you should not feel the pressure to strictly adhere to
whatever idea a class presents you with. Experimentation with niche options and
tactics is not just supported, but encouraged.
The full list of class archetypes and classes is:
Champion - Physically capable warriors who put a great deal of effort into
bettering their bodies.
● Berserker - Brutal melee warriors
● Legionary - Disciplined soldiers and combat engineers
● Warden - Heavily armored guardians and diplomats
● Marksman - Precise hunters and snipers
Scoundrel - Shady and resourceful operatives who prefer subversive tactics and
unfair advantages.
● Duelist - Cunning fighters and socialites
● Rogue - Stealthy thieves and operatives
● Stalker - Crafty lurkers and trappers
● Gunslinger - Firearms wielding vigilantes and mercenaries

Guide - Charismatic and inspiring leaders who focus on bolstering their allies and
providing support.
● Bard - Ambedo-powered bannermen
● Envoy - Charismatic leaders and tacticians
● Wayfarer - Resilient navigators and couriers
Scholar - Educated specialists and ambedo experts who prefer to rely on science
and technology over more primitive approaches.
● Apothecary - Intelligent alchemists and poisoners
● Clairvoyant - Ambedo scientists and detectives
● Mechanist - Ambedic drone and mech operators
Mystic - Radical idealists who manifest their Season’s will through their strict
adherence to its ideals.
● Arbiter - Gravity bending mages of Trumst
● Empath - Cryptic mind mages of Bruma
● Sorcerer - Passionate pyromancers of Vamor
● Witch - Occult necromancers of Halice
Aberration - Beastly individuals possessing terrible abilities and bearing
dehumanizing curses.
● Protean - Void-touched shapeshifters
● Vessel - Parasite-infested blood mages

sections.title: Berserker
sections.content:
# Berserker

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 58-61 -->  
**Archetype:** Champion · Risky · Brutal  
**Recommended disciplines:** Warfare  
**Recommended special skills:** Stance, Carry, Authority, Discipline  

> The guard had been mocking him for the past hour. Having drunk a sufficient quantity of absinthe, he was ready to return the favour. First, he swung his crude mace directly at his plated chest, denting the armour plates towards him and breaking his ribcage. As the guard fell to his knees, gasping for air, he aligned his arms for another swing, blowing apart the guard’s horrified, gasping face onto the nearby wall, just like his father had taught him. When the townsfolk found him, he was quickly subdued and they prepared a nearby tree for a mob lynching. As he was hanged for his crimes, for the first time in his life, he would ponder the downsides of violence. He rapidly rose through the ranks, earning a medal every other engagement. He was the unit’s greatest asset, his brutality, efficiency and bravery unmatched. After one such skirmish and the following alcohol-laden celebration, he would visit his lover’s tent in search of warmth. His heart would sink when she met his presence with a wide look and dilated pupils, an expression all too familiar to his murderous body. Taking her for a simple farmer, the lowlives had surrounded her and were already throwing about nasty suggestions. Trying to maintain a facade of bravery, she slashed one’s leg with her father’s scythe, half-severing it. As the bandit bled on the ground she pushed her hand into the wound, licked a few drops of his blood and then smeared it all over her face. In a moment of shock she cut down the second bandit as the last one ran for the forest path they arrived from. When the screaming subsided she dropped her implement, sat down and began to quietly sob. Berserkers are simple and brutal warriors - they utilize their great strength to quickly lay waste to the enemy, usually wielding two-handed weapons and not wearing any armour that would unnecessarily slow them down. They often make use of intimidation to get their way, leading others to view them as dangerous individuals even when not wielding a weapon.

## Class Features
#### Reckless Abandon — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you perform an attack, you may have it deal +X damage and suffer -X EVA until your next turn where X is your GRT+REF up to a maximum of 4.

#### >>> Breakthrough — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +2 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** If this attack kills or incapacitates your target, gain an additional movement action and repeat it at no Strain cost. Breakthrough can only be repeated like this once per round.

#### | Rooted Blows — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Lose your movement action for this turn. Breakthrough can repeat twice upon incapacitating or killing a target this round.

## Path: Revenant
*An unstoppable offensive path that excels under pressure and grows more powerful after suffering damage.*

#### Defiant Rage — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Gain +1 ACC and +2 DMG while at half or lower of your HP max.

#### > Power Through — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain 3 TVG. This effect does not stack.

#### > Tear Muscle — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** You may lose an amount of HP less than or equal to your GRT and inflict that much additional DMG on your next attack this turn. This ability may be used in place of your movement action for the turn instead.

## Path: Ravager
*A bleed-focused path that inflicts terror in groups of enemies.*

#### Bloodbath — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you inflict Bleeding, inflict equal Stun to enemies within C of the target (not the target themselves).

#### > Bloody Revelry — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Intimidate all bleeding enemies within your line of sight (CL 3 Willpower save). Until your next turn, roll your attacks against them with advantage.

#### >>> Spill Guts — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack may target any number of targets and gains +1 ACC for each additional target. Inflict Bleeding 2.

sections.title: Legionary
sections.content:
# Legionary

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 62-65 -->  
**Archetype:** Champion · Breacher · Formation  
**Recommended disciplines:** Warfare/Duel, Leadership  
**Recommended special skills:** Carry, Engineering, Stance, Scout  

> He was not just another cog in the machine. His will and his might would change this broken world. Equipped with the latest and best equipment Eterion had to offer, he would tame the unreality with his virtuous comrades. His blade had been sharpened for hours. His armour shone like a bright, silvery gemstone. His shield concealed a tiny cannon, the pride and joy of his homeland’s military engineers. All of his bravado would fade at the sight of his own blood soaking an enemy’s crude, serrated implement. She had spent enough time in this place to understand its calculus. The ore had to reach the port in two days, passing through a famously lethal mountain pass, then through an active warzone only to end up in cannibal infested woodlands. The price of ore is well known, as is the price of a soul. She added up the costs and assigned the indebted men and women to their duties, those more experienced to the transport, those less fortunate to “protection” squads. She thought this exchange rational, thinking she would feel at peace with her own duty when it was time for her to do the same. They stood shoulder to shoulder, inseparable since childhood. They had the entire song and dance down to a science. A shieldbearer in the front, a gunman to take out those who would sabotage their little formation in the back and two warriors to the sides, mowing down whatever got caught on their long blades. A moment of distraction was all it took for the firebomb to hit them, for the gunman to be set ablaze. With all of the grace and delirium of an amputee, they would march on like usual, holding on to their crushed souls, as if that would bring him back from the ashes. Legionaries are trained and versatile servants. They perform a variety of duties ranging from warfare to construction and logistics, serving as the backbone of any modern task force. Some specialize in close quarters combat, others prefer ranged weapons, what binds them are the creative ways in which they outplay their opponents. No matter their origin or style, legionaries are industrious combat engineers disciplined enough to achieve any task, given enough resources or souls.

## Class Features
#### Always Prepared — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Heal 2 Strain whenever you use a consumable item or perform an attack with a weapon you have equipped since the beginning of your previous turn. Suffer 6 Strain whenever you witness an ally being reduced to 0 HP.

#### >> Tactical Breach — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** You may freely holster any weapons and items and suffer -4 EVA until your next turn. Perform a +2 ACC attack using a newly equipped weapon or consumable that heals 2 Strain of all allies with half or more of their SL if successful.

#### >> Solid Formation — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** You and all allies that are in your A or are also adjacent to these allies are considered a part of your formation and cannot be flanked. Until your next turn allies in your formation gain +1 EVA and you suffer 1 Strain whenever they are damaged.

## Path: Exemplar
*Path that specializes in decisive strikes and capitalizes on any opportunities that present themselves.*

#### Perfect Moment — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Each time an enemy fails to hit you or an ally within your M you gain one Perfect Moment Charge. Upon reaching the maximum of 4 Charges, you may spend them while performing Tactical Breach in order to empower it while suffering an additional -2 EVA: Bold Offensive: You and an ally of your choice gain a Temporary Destiny Point that lasts until the end of the encounter. Aligned Axis: You and an ally of your choice gain +1 AP and +2 ACC until your next turn. ●

#### >> Measured Response — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +3 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** When you perform this attack, any number of your allies may also perform it at no Strain cost. Everyone who manages to hit their target gains +3 EVA until their next turn. ●

#### >> Secure Position — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** If you have successfully performed a Tactical Breach during your previous turn, this ability costs 1 AP less to perform. Restore 4 Strain up to half of your SL maximum.

## Path: Banneret
*Path that focuses on ally support and coordinating formations.*

#### Bound Fates — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You and all allies that are in your C or are also adjacent to these allies are considered a part of your formation. Abilities affecting your allies cost 1 Strain less to perform while you are in a formation with two or more allies.

#### >> Triumphant Presence — *Defensive*
Class *
**4 Strain** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** This ability additionally costs 1 Destiny Point if it has been used the previous turn. Allies within your formation gain your choice of the following until your next turn: ● +2 ACC on ranged attacks, -2 EVA ● +2 TVG, -2 tiles of movement ● +1 tile of range on melee attacks, +1 Strain cost on abilities.

#### < Hopebearer — *Utility*
Class *
**5 Strain**  
**Effect:** Whenever an attack would reduce you to 0 or less HP, an ally within your C may take that much damage +3 instead of you.

sections.content:
# Marksman

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 66-69 -->  
**Archetype:** Champion · Sniper · AreaControl  
**Recommended disciplines:** Precision, Protection  
**Recommended special skills:** Scout, Interface, Engineering, Pilot  

> When his village was overrun by the tall, slender stalkers, most of his neighbours tried to fight them. While some managed to wound a few, they were quickly torn apart and strung up on the nearby trees. As he watched all this from his attic hiding spot, a crossbow beside him, he fought and pleaded with his heart to show restraint, to show patience. When one of the stalkers inspected his house and concluded there was nobody inside, it settled down below his hiding spot and entered a sort of stasis. Before him was now a simple shot that would give him a chance at surviving this night, bought by his refusal to submit to a more primal response. As the sun was nearing its zenith, the contestants readied their rifles. Her engraved antique shined as bright as ever when the starting shot was issued. A plume of smoke erupted from her firearm as she executed the first target. The recoil felt right, just the way she always practiced. Not a second later, she had already rotated the weapon’s barrel mechanism and was ready to fire again. In what felt like a sudden and sharp blink, all three targets were felled from a hundred meters’ distance. She claimed her aim got better the further away the targets were, that distance allowed her to focus more on the target rather than the person. He drew his bow and turned around the corner, pointing it towards someone he thought was his nemesis. Instead his gaze was met by a frightened child, inexplicably and shakily holding a dragon pistol in her hands. He tried to defuse the situation, yet her fear was stronger. He pleaded with her to resolve this peacefully, yet she wouldn’t trust him. Having held the bow drawn for so long, his arms began to strain and he made a rare choice to show restraint in hopes of avoiding the slaughter of a child. As he was about to point the bow away she mistook his movement for an assault, discharging a blast of shrapnel towards him. This scene would be burned deep into his mind when his eyes were torn apart by the bits of deformed metal. Marksmen are proficient hunters, archers and gunners. Marksmen often choose a type of ranged weapon to stick to above others, allowing them to reach unparalleled levels of precision. When they settle into their preferred armament, they will either dedicate fully to accurate, long distance shots combined with shotcalling or adapt a more mobile hit-and-run strategy. Good marksmen are a backbone of any competent or otherwise combat unit and are feared by all melee combatants.

## Class Features
#### Empowered Shot — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You gain 1 Empowered Shot Charge whenever you perform a ranged attack. Upon reaching the maximum of 3 Charges, you may spend them while performing any ranged attack in order to empower it: Volley: Repeat this attack at no Strain cost. Refresh: This attack gains +2 ACC. After performing it, heal 6 Strain if you are at half or above of your SL and reload your currently equipped weapon.

#### >> Prepare Shot — *Defensive*
Class *
**1 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** During your next turn, your first attack gains +X ACC where X is your class rank.

#### >> Overwatch — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, gain 3 additional reactions that can be used as a ranged attack that has -1 ACC and +0 DMG. These reactions trigger upon enemy movement within your line of sight.

## Path: Sharpshot
*Path that specializes in accurate, long range shots and team support through target painting.*

#### Headhunter — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever your ranged attack hits a target for 4 or more above their EVA, heal 2 Strain and gain a stacking +1 ranged DMG bonus that lasts until the end of the encounter. Empowered Shot gains the following option at 2 Charges: Judgement: Your next attack gains +2 ACC, +3 DMG and Pierce 3.

#### > Tracking Shot — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**1 SN** · +0 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Regardless of the attack's success, you and your allies gain +1 ACC against the target for 2 rounds. This effect can reach a total of +2 ACC.

#### < Repel The Savages — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy entering your M range.

## Path: Venator
*Mobile path that excels at hit-and-run tactics, being able to rapidly redeploy while firing.*

#### Frontline Assault — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you perform a ranged attack targeting an enemy within your C, gain +1 Empowered shot Charge. Empowered Shot gains the following option at 2 Charges: Tempo: Gain +2 EVA until your next turn. Gain an additional movement action.

#### < Return Fire — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on a ranged attack being used against you.

#### >> Combined Offensive — *Melee + Ranged Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Perform this as two attacks in any order - one melee and one ranged. You may use your movement action in between them. You may freely holster weapons in between them.

sections.title: Warden
sections.content:
# Warden

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 70-73 -->  
**Archetype:** Champion · Enforcer · Guardian  
**Recommended disciplines:** Protection  

> The patrons’ voices grew ever louder, turning from cheers into a heated debate. Music soon stopped and only the drunken yells could be heard throughout the establishment. A menacing figure pushed through the crowd to stand before the instigator, measuring him up in silence. The instigator apologized, sat down, and the brawl was postponed to a later date. The novice desperately tried to hold off the approaching branches with his spear as his allies’ breathless bodies hung strung above him. As one took hold of him, just as swiftly was it chopped off by a powerful swing of an axe. A hulking, metal figure grabbed the novice, pulling him through the thick bushes from which she came. The novice pleaded with her to return for his comrades, yet she would not allow herself to feel sorry. That novice was not the first nor the last one she would have to drag out of hell that night As he stood behind his lord listening to his speech, his mind wandered to his childhood. He recalled standing on a similar podium, tiny and scared, watching his mother be brought to the gallows. The lord still spoke in a similar manner, high and mighty, though his voice was much less intimidating coming from his present hunched, frail form. Armored from head to toe, he walked up to the lord and squeezed him by the neck. While he knew that he would be struck down, he was sure that his loyal shell would let him finish this final task with entire seconds to spare. Wardens are heavily armored fighters serving as the frontline of any force they are a part of. Often trained in more diplomatic approaches, their aim is to prevent conflict first and defend second. If their menacing presence doesn’t defuse the situation by itself, their prowess and brutality eventually will.

## Class Features
#### Iron Golem — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever one of your armour points are broken, you gain 3 TVG. Whenever you restore an armour point, you gain +1 DMG until your next turn.

#### < Bodyguard — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an ally within your movement distance being targeted by an attack. You move next to the ally, exchange places with them and change the target of the attack to yourself if it is a melee attack. If it is a ranged attack, you instead move at any point between the attacker and the targeted ally and change the target of the attack to yourself. Restore 1 armour point.

#### >> Invite Punishment — *Defensive*
Class *
**2 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Taunt up to two target enemies (CL 14 Willpower save). Restore 3 Strain for each enemy you successfully taunt this way.

## Path: Juggernaut
*Path that grows more destructive as it loses armour.*

#### Unburdened — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may choose to deplete all of your armour points at the start of your turn. If you do, gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of that turn.

#### >> Regain Composure — *Defensive*
Class *
**3 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Regain 2 armour points if you have no armour points. Restore 7 Strain if you have more than half of your SL.

#### >> Locomotive — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +2 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Perform an additional movement action. You may pass through enemies as you perform it and knock them and the attack’s target prone (CL 14 Stance save).

## Path: Sentinel
*Intimidation focused path that spread terror throughout the battlefield.*

#### Gaze and Tremble — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you Taunt or Intimidate an enemy, you may instead inflict the other of the effects. Instead of having a duration, those status effects last until the afflicted enemy successfully deals DMG to you. Deal +1 Stun and +1 Break against targets you have Taunted or Intimidated.

#### > Tremendous Presence — *Defensive*
Class *
**3 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, enemies you have Taunted or Intimidated suffer your choice of the following: ● -2 ACC ● -2 EVA ● -1 Tile of Movement Speed

#### > Opress — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 2 and Break 2.

sections.title: Duelist
sections.content:
# Duelist

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 74-77 -->  
**Archetype:** Scoundrel · Elegant · Tempo  
**Recommended disciplines:** Duel  
**Recommended special skills:** Stance, Deception, Authority, Lore  

> As the feast was nearing its end, she arose from her seat, an old flimsy rapier on her hip, and issued a challenge for the rank to her commanding officer. He snickered among his close associates, calling on his armored warden to duel in his stead. She engaged the iron golem in a mockery of a fencing match, making provocative yet harmless strikes at his iron shell. When the golem decided to end the duel by simply coming at her, she made a final feint, snapped open his visor and shot him with a gun concealed within her sleeve. While she may have been shaken, her body would never betray her by showing it to the silent crowd. He had been sent to quell a peasant uprising in the borderlands. His trained men had made quick work of the rabble. Descending upon the rebels’ last stronghold, they would be greeted not by desperate resistance, but a single, disheveled man, offering to resolve the issue with only a single death. They agreed on the terms - immediate surrender or mercy for the rebels. His shiny engraved saber had crossed with many blades, yet never had it met a piece of iron as crude and frail as his opponent’s rusty sword. In but a few swings he had cut off the rebel leader’s hand, yet the sight of his surrendered body kneeling in the mud stopped his arm from performing the final swing. Without a single word, he would turn back and order his men to depart the hamlet. When she woke up her rival’s mercenaries had already begun torching the manor. She would usher her children and servants through the secret passage, shoving various heirlooms into their shaking hands. By the time they were all safe her muscles were tired and her throat burned. Coughing, half dressed and a molten blade in hand, she had emerged through the front entrance and waved a challenge to her murderers. They had to see her go down if her children were to ever live in peace. Her broken, charred body would display all of her life’s achievements to a dozen of them before it finally ran out of adrenaline. In her final moments, she laid down her blade and kneeled before her decapitators, taking one final look at the stars. Duelists are skilled and elegant fighters who specialize in single combat. Unlike the more savage warriors of the world, they are more akin to entertainers, putting on a good show in addition to slaying their foe. They prefer one handed weapons paired with either a parrying tool or a sidearm, utilizing a complex combat technique in order to gain advantage. Their form is perfect and their reflexes sharp - no trick will surprise them.

## Class Features
#### Duel Etiquette — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** After performing an attack that requires 2 or more AP, enter the Offensive Stance. After using a defensive action enter the Defensive Stance. Offensive Stance: You gain +1 DMG and your melee attacks inflict Pierce 1. Defensive Stance: You gain +1 EVA.

#### >> Fleche — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +3 ACC if you have moved towards your target this turn. Offensive Stance: Gain a free movement action. This attack deals +2 DMG.

#### >> Anticipate — *Defensive*
Class *
**2 SN** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** Offensive Stance: During your next turn gain +2 ACC for each attack made against you from now until that turn. Defensive Stance: Heal 3 Strain for each attack made against you until your next turn.

## Path: Nemesis
*A risky offensive path that sacrifices all defenses for unparalleled lethality.*

#### Rising Momentum — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Gain +1 DMG on each consecutive successful attack. When you are hit while this bonus is active, that attack gains the bonus instead and the bonus is reset.

#### > Lethal Tempo — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Whenever you deal DMG this round, heal an equal amount of Strain.

#### >> Blade Waltz — *Melee Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +2 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Offensive Stance: This attack may be repeated for any number of different enemies. Movement actions may be used in between these additional attacks.

## Path: Gallant
*Balanced path that prioritizes defense while waiting for a perfect moment to strike.*

#### Rising Tension — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Gain an additional reaction every round while in Defensive Stance. Fleche has +1 DMG and inflicts Pierce 2 in the Defensive Stance.

#### > Backup Plan — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +2 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack doesn’t suffer penalties for being performed at A range. Only usable with a 1H ranged weapon. Enter any Stance or remove your current Stance.

#### >> Coup — *Defensive*
Class *
**6 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Disarm an adjacent target (CL 18 Stance Save).

He snickered among his close associates, calling on his armored warden to duel in his stead. She engaged the iron golem in a mockery of a fencing match, making provocative yet harmless strikes at his iron shell. When the golem decided to end the duel by simply coming at her, she made a final feint, snapped open his visor and shot him with a gun concealed within her sleeve. While she may have been shaken, her body would never betray her by showing it to the silent crowd. He had been sent to quell a peasant uprising in the borderlands. His trained men had made quick work of the rabble. Descending upon the rebels’ last stronghold, they would be greeted not by desperate resistance, but a single, disheveled man, offering to resolve the issue with only a single death. They agreed on the terms - immediate surrender or mercy for the rebels. His shiny engraved saber had crossed with many blades, yet never had it met a piece of iron as crude and frail as his opponent’s rusty sword. In but a few swings he had cut off the rebel leader’s hand, yet the sight of his surrendered body kneeling in the mud stopped his arm from performing the final swing. Without a single word, he would turn back and order his men to depart the hamlet. When she woke up her rival’s mercenaries had already begun torching the manor. She would usher her children and servants through the secret passage, shoving various heirlooms into their shaking hands. By the time they were all safe her muscles were tired and her throat burned. Coughing, half dressed and a molten blade in hand, she had emerged through the front entrance and waved a challenge to her murderers. They had to see her go down if her children were to ever live in peace. Her broken, charred body would display all of her life’s achievements to a dozen of them before it finally ran out of adrenaline. In her final moments, she laid down her blade and kneeled before her decapitators, taking one final look at the stars. Duelists are skilled and elegant fighters who specialize in single combat. Unlike the more savage warriors of the world, they are more akin to entertainers, putting on a good show in addition to slaying their foe. They prefer one handed weapons paired with either a parrying tool or a sidearm, utilizing a complex combat technique in order to gain advantage. Their form is perfect and their reflexes sharp - no trick will surprise them. sections.content:
# Gunslinger

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 78-81 -->  
**Archetype:** Scoundrel · RapidFire · Explosive  
**Recommended disciplines:** Precision  

> He could not save his mother from the marauders. He spent hours wandering the wasteland, aimlessly looking for his final resting place. He finally sat down on the dusty, dry ground in the shade of some tall rocks, his look gazing at his final sunset. He must have sat there for over an hour, shifting his look from the sun to his father’s pistol. It did not save his mother, but it did save him, and that must count for something. His life was already gone, what difference did it make if he ended it all here or in some desperate attempt to redeem his failure while saving another life? As he dwelled on these thoughts, he felt a thirst return to his throat, and his stomach alerted him that he would in fact, not mind a dinner. She was known amongst her colleagues for rarely using her gun. Despite this, she practiced her aim more than anyone. Her work in the Etergarde had increasingly been forcing her into hostile confrontations, and her methods of dialogue and empathy sometimes just didn’t work. When she did draw her weapon, she had to be sure that the shot would not kill. Those few times she failed she would scratch another line into both her implement and her arm. The list would serve as a reminder of how many drinks she would need to order whenever she started to hear their bloodied gurgles and pained screams again. He had four belts lined with pistols, two rifles on his shoulders and a whole arsenal of bombs. He was not scared of any kind of company or gang - he had enough gunpowder for them all. He left scorched earth and graveyards of slavers everywhere he passed. As it tends to go, he would meet his end in one of his massive shootouts, peppered by bullets and finally stabbed and beaten to death by some armed adolescents. In his last few breaths he thought back to where he made the mistake, reliving his final standoff. It was not there. He thought further back, searched far and wide for the cause of his death. He didn’t have time to finish his thesis, but in this oblivious state it occurred to him that no matter how many of them he killed, more would rise up to take their place. With hundreds of souls to his name and fear in his heart, he considered if he did the right thing. Gunlingers are outlaws and vigilantes, those who wander the world in search of a purpose with a firearm at their side. They see their guns as the great equalizers that they are and use them to attempt to change the world through “civilized” violence. Whether they do this by a single, devastating headshot or a barrage of fire, you can be sure to expect them not to miss their mark. Most gunslingers die as they lived – alone, full of energy and pondering all of the things they still didn’t change.

## Class Features
#### Showdown — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You gain 1 Empowered Shot Charge whenever you perform a ranged attack. Upon reaching the maximum of 3 Charges, you may spend them while performing any pistol ranged attack in order to empower it: Zenith: This attack gains Pierce 3 and +3 DMG. Nadir: This attack heals 4 SN and gains +2 ACC.

#### < Quickdraw — *Ranged Attack*
Class  · Weapons: Pistol*
**2 SN** · +1 ACC · +3 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers upon entering combat. This attack is only usable against targets who have not yet acted.

#### | Lightning Hands — *Ranged Attack*
Class  · Weapons: Pistol*
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Gains +2 DMG when used against a target who hasn’t had a turn during this combat round.

## Path: Marauder
*Path that fully locks into rapid and powerful barrages.*

#### Morning Sun — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Holstering Pistol and Rifles is a free action. Your Pistol and Rifles gain +1 DMG per attack you perform with either of them in a turn until the end of that turn. Showdown gains the following option at 3 Charges: Mayhem: Gain 3 AP and suffer 4 Strain. You may use abilities again this turn.

#### >>> Faceoff — *Ranged Attack*
Class  · Weapons: Pistol*
**6 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** You may target any number of additional targets with this attack and it costs 2 additional Strain per target beyond the first.

#### >> Wasteful Barrage — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 Strain** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Empty your weapon’s entire magazine into a target in cover. The target and other creatures within its A suffer 1 DMG per ammo you depleted this way.

## Path: Drifter
*Path that shifts more into stealth and evasion, increasing the class’ frontline survivability.*

#### Evening Breeze — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** While you are in Stealth, restore 2 VG while at less than half of your max VG and reduce the level of all damaging status effects by 1 at the end of your turn. Showdown gains the following option at 3 Charges: Fade: Enter Stealth if you end your turn in cover and out of direct line of sight of your enemies.

#### >> Masterful Shot — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**6 Strain** · +2 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** You may activate any Empowered Shot effect without spending charges when you perform this ability. Gain +2 EVA until your next turn.

#### < Pain Tolerance — *Utility*
Class *
**5 Strain**  
**Effect:** Triggers on you being damaged by an enemy. Gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of your next turn.

sections.title: Rogue
sections.content:
# Rogue

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 82-85 -->  
**Archetype:** Scoundrel · Stealth · Planning  
**Recommended disciplines:** Shadow  

> When her mother disappeared she tried her best to make it work. She offered herself for all sorts of work, yet most would reject her for her nearly skeletal appearance. How was she to feed her baby brother without money? A loaf of bread stolen here, some jewelry snatched in a busy street there – sometimes she felt like she could really make it work. Other times they’d go a week without food, becoming more jaded with the indifference of the world, becoming more open to depraved acts. She went over this in her head a thousand times before torching those fields, consulting her heart. She would take what was rightfully hers, they left her no other choice. The newspaper spoke of a legendary marauder being finally put in his place by the heroic militias. He was in the business of offering “protection” to hamlets and villages, aided by his countless demonstrations of why protection was needed. The tyrant ruled the region with an iron fist for a decade, and nobody could or bothered to muster enough firepower to repel his minions. The twist lay in the fact that he had not perished due to the heroism of small people, but a personal and deeply uncharacteristic blunder. In his final year, he had fallen madly in love with a local woman, going as far as to conceive a child. He would cut corners from his vast empire, all to fund a majestic homestead for his new family. After months of infiltrating this undersupplied network, the militias had finally caught wind of the location of his family home. The article concluded by jubilantly describing the remnants of that tragic scene, ending it by mockingly referring to the deceased as being “killed by sentimentality”. She wiped the fresh blood from her blade. This night's work had been the final point in her grand plan, and with a little luck, this may very well have been her last kill. The six of them hadn’t even noticed she snuck into the building, and with her swift movements she made sure to both secure her position at the top of the city’s underground and to eliminate the final person who could identify her. The moon was full that night, and a slight breeze signaled that it was the perfect time to enjoy the sights of the grand metropolis. She climbed one of the ruined towers, making a final mental check, confirming she was materially set for life. Reaching the top she made herself comfortable on one of the overgrown edges of the railing, picking up a white flower that grew there. She smelled it and looked over her city, content, happy for the first time since she could remember. Gazing over the families enjoying the evening she felt her heart skip a beat. Spotting some couples out on a walk made her suddenly feel cold. She quickly shook it off and went back down, assuring herself that ghosts are best left unseen. Rogues are chaotic and resourceful operatives and swords for hire. They excel in ambushes and other underhanded tactics, preferring to make their own luck instead of wasting time on concepts like training and discipline. Distractions are a rogue’s favorite weapon, be they loud and explosive or more subtle and elegant. Rogues come from various molds, ranging from simple highwaymen and bandits to eloquent members of high society.

## Class Features
#### Veil of Shadows — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Gain advantage on rolls being performed in Stealth while near creatures who would be hostile to this action. You may enter Stealth whenever you use a defensive action while in full cover and out of enemies’ lines of sight. While in Stealth, the cost of abilities you perform is reduced by 2 Strain.

#### > Wicked Glint — *Ranged Attack*
Class  · Weapons: Stealth*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack suffers no penalties for being performed at A range. If you have a free hand, you may use holstered weapons to perform this attack.

#### >> Swift Resupply — *Defensive*
Class *
**2 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** When performing this ability in cover, choose two of the following: ● Restore 1 VG ● Restore 1 SN ● Freely holster and equip weapons ● Gain +1 EVA until your next turn ● Use or apply a consumable to your equipment

## Path: Brigand
*Path that grows bolder in its risk-taking, preferring to continue the fight after an explosive entrance.*

#### Stacked Sleeve — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may use Pistol and consumables with Wicked Glint. Whenever you perform a defensive action, you may reload any equipped weapon by paying 1 Strain.

#### >> Explosive Deterrent — *Defensive*
Class *
**3 SN** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** Use an explosive consumable and gain a free movement action.

#### | Last Drop — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Only usable against targets who have 2 or less VG.

## Path: Phantom
*Elusive path that weaves in and out of combat, cleanly eliminating its enemies one by one.*

#### Flawless Misdirection — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may enter Stealth via the effects of Veil of Shadows while in ¾ cover. Wicked glint may be performed with no bonus DMG from ACC overflow without breaking Stealth.

#### > Shocking Display — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Your next attack while in Stealth inflicts Stun 2 on up to two targets within your target’s M. This effect lasts until your next turn.

#### >>> Silent Elimination — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**6 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +8 DMG against Unaware targets. If it kills the target while you are in Stealth, you remain in Stealth. Usable only with quiet weapons.

sections.title: Stalker
sections.content:
# Stalker

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 86-89 -->  
**Archetype:** Scoundrel · Traps · AreaControl  
**Recommended disciplines:** Shadow/Duel  

> The trees surrounding his perimeter all had malicious, highly toxic lichens growing on their bark. The paths leading to his shack had multiple concealed pits with falls landing onto carefully placed rusty, metal spikes. Various zones of his territory had an intricate tripwire system that would alert him if any kind of intruder dared to enter. He would spend the long nights maintaining this web of pain and watching the area from the dim rooms of his hideout, a weapon always at the ready. He had caught enough meat to last him a lifetime. In his domain, he was content. They left her alone to deal with the bounty she took on. No matter, she thought, they were never going to act as anything but bait to begin with. Luring the rebellious drake to the location was easy - she just needed some fresh carcasses. Trapping it within the cavern was an engineering problem, but ultimately one solvable through raw mechanical force. When all of this was finally done, all that was left was to immobilize its large clawed wings and finally engage it in a show of dominance. Any sane person would have feared for their life engaging a drake in combat under even the most favorable of circumstances. She, being the opposite, was the only person capable of singlehandedly dominating and retrieving a lost dragon. They had begun torching his woodland. For all of its faults and malice, he knew no other home, and he would not stand idly by as it was consumed. Gathering his few neighbours, they would embark on a campaign of retaliation. They’d work in tandem with the vile forest, arranging traps that would deliver their victims to its living roots and less human dwellers. When all was set and ready, he would join the hunt himself, abandoning what he had left in favor of the only place he ever called home. Despite Beothran’s horrors, he felt she would appreciate him more than any righteous easterner ever had. Stalkers are lurking hunters utilizing a wide arsenal of traps, hazards and capture equipment to displace and immobilize their targets. They are often loners living on the edges of civilisation, content with living in solitude while providing services that are often looked down upon in polite society. Some work as bounty hunters, others act as the protectors of nature, some become specialized operatives in more urban environments. In all cases, stalkers rely on their vast knowledge of their target area to spatially dominate their foes before using simpler tools and forces to complete their tasks.

## Class Features
#### Unfair Advantage — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever an enemy triggers one of your traps or hazards, choose one of the following: ● Heal 3 Strain. ● Gain a reaction. ● Gain +2 ACC against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

#### < Opportune Strike — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers upon enemy triggering a trap or hazard. Gains +2 DMG if triggered by a trap.

#### > Morbid Showcase — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · 1 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Push 1 in any direction.

## Path: Trapper
*Path that emphasizes traps over hazards and cares about setting up a perfect combo to knock out large opponents.*

#### Vicious Design — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Unfair Advantage gains the following option when triggered by a trap: ● The enemy suffers Bleeding 2. ● The enemy suffers Feeble 3

#### > Reset Mechanism — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Rearm a trap you have set up or set up a trap within your A.

#### < Merciful End — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**6 Strain** · +0 ACC · +6 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy reaching half or less of their maximum HP upon triggering your trap.

## Path: Poacher
*Path that specializes in area control and environmental hazards. Path Passive Ability:*

#### Cruel Domain — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Successful attacks you perform on enemies standing within your hazards inflict Fractured equal to the amount of AP you spent on the attack.

#### < Better View — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy triggering your hazard. Gain and use a movement action.

#### | Hunting Grounds — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Deploy a hazard.

The paths leading to his shack had multiple concealed pits with falls landing onto carefully placed rusty, metal spikes. Various zones of his territory had an intricate tripwire system that would alert him if any kind of intruder dared to enter. He would spend the long nights maintaining this web of pain and watching the area from the dim rooms of his hideout, a weapon always at the ready. He had caught enough meat to last him a lifetime. In his domain, he was content. They left her alone to deal with the bounty she took on. No matter, she thought, they were never going to act as anything but bait to begin with. Luring the rebellious drake to the location was easy - she just needed some fresh carcasses. Trapping it within the cavern was an engineering problem, but ultimately one solvable through raw mechanical force. When all of this was finally done, all that was left was to immobilize its large clawed wings and finally engage it in a show of dominance. Any sane person would have feared for their life engaging a drake in combat under even the most favorable of circumstances. She, being the opposite, was the only person capable of singlehandedly dominating and retrieving a lost dragon. They had begun torching his woodland. For all of its faults and malice, he knew no other home, and he would not stand idly by as it was consumed. Gathering his few neighbours, they would embark on a campaign of retaliation. They’d work in tandem with the vile forest, arranging traps that would deliver their victims to its living roots and less human dwellers. When all was set and ready, he would join the hunt himself, abandoning what he had left in favor of the only place he ever called home. Despite Beothran’s horrors, he felt she would appreciate him more than any righteous easterner ever had. Stalkers are lurking hunters utilizing a wide arsenal of traps, hazards and capture equipment to displace and immobilize their targets. They are often loners living on the edges of civilisation, content with living in solitude while providing services that are often looked down upon in polite society. Some work as bounty hunters, others act as the protectors of nature, some become specialized operatives in more urban environments. In all cases, stalkers rely on their vast knowledge of their target area to spatially dominate their foes before using simpler tools and forces to complete their tasks. Class Features Unfair Advantage — Passive Class  Effect: Whenever an enemy triggers one of your traps or hazards, choose one of the following: ● Heal 3 Strain. ● Gain a reaction. ● Gain +2 ACC against that enemy until the end of your next turn. < Opportune Strike — Melee/Ranged Attack Class  0 SN · +0 ACC · +0 DMG Effect: Triggers upon enemy triggering a trap or hazard. Gains +2 DMG if triggered by a trap. Morbid Showcase — Melee/Ranged Attack Class  2 SN · +0 ACC · 1 DMG Effect: Inflict Push 1 in any direction. Path: Trapper Path that emphasizes traps over hazards and cares about setting up a perfect combo to knock out large opponents. Vicious Design — Passive Class  Effect: Unfair Advantage gains the following option when triggered by a trap: ● The enemy suffers Bleeding 2. ● The enemy suffers Feeble 3 Reset Mechanism — Utility Class  3 SN Effect: Rearm a trap you have set up or set up a trap within your A. < Merciful End — Melee/Ranged Attack Class  6 Strain · +0 ACC · +6 DMG Effect: Triggers on an enemy reaching half or less of their maximum HP upon triggering your trap. Path: Poacher Path that specializes in area control and environmental hazards. Path Passive Ability: Cruel Domain — Passive Class  Effect: Successful attacks you perform on enemies standing within your hazards inflict Fractured equal to the amount of AP you spent on the attack. < Better View — Utility Class  2 SN Effect: Triggers on an enemy triggering your hazard. Gain and use a movement action. Hunting Grounds — Utility Class  4 SN Effect: Deploy a hazard.

sections.title: Bard
sections.content:
# Bard

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 90-93 -->  
**Archetype:** Guide · Auras · Channelling  
**Recommended disciplines:** Leadership  
**Recommended special skills:** Whisper, Lore, Carry, Deception  

> He stood upon the stage, the festival crowd below him, humming along to his melody. They did not know it, but this night would stay with them forever. After a brief pause, he inserted an ambedic crystal into his modified violin, a shard containing the happiest of memories he had shared with his late wife. Though he played a familiar love song, his reproduction gave it a surreal texture as the shard emitted its contents to those who bore witness. The song, a well-known common vessel, had been applied magnificently to instill the most human of memories within the audience. She was the first person they would turn to whenever they would encounter even a slight obstacle. She did not simply reproduce legendary music, she warped it beyond recognition into the specific, unique form for every situation that required it. Her songs turned cowards and lowlives into determined, unstoppable machines with naught but sound and emotion. Her melodies pushed individual heroes to their absolute limits. Her delusional, assuring lyrics lured them to their deaths at the hands of an enemy no sane person would have confronted. Their loss was no matter, though, as she could always record their own final moments and twist them to inspire her next band. He was beyond conviction and beyond care. He was left all alone, and his supply of blood was rapidly running out. He prepared his instrument for the final performance, connecting directly to its ambedic mechanism. The almost silent melody grew in strength as they peppered him with arrows. At first the sound was just grating, a minor inconvenience. When he started deliriously singing, blood bubbling in his mouth, his audience was hit by countless invisible slashes, reflecting his wounds upon them. When he finally collapsed, the song continued to escalate into an incomprehensible cacophony, turning his murderers into a writhing funeral pyre. Bards are artists and amplifiers of emotion. They utilize instruments modified to host ambedic crystals, turning their performances from simple music to powerful psychological auras. Bards inspire their allies beyond anything commonly possible, and they stunt their enemies in ways they can hardly comprehend. This shaping and warping of known songs taps into the powers of the seasons without conviction, relying instead on pure emotion and memory to fuel the process.

## Class Features
#### Transmitter — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** A specialized ambedic device connected to your instrument allows you to play it even while it is not equipped. Channeled abilities using your instruments only cost you up to 1 AP total to upkeep per turn.

#### | Theme Variation — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** If you are already performing a channeled ability with your instrument, immediately perform another one and continue to channel both of them without paying an AP cost. You may only channel up to two abilities at once using this ability.

#### >> Trance — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Heal 2 Strain for each channeled instrument ability you are currently performing.

## Path: Laureate
*A supportive path that bolsters and rallies its allies to perform unimaginable feats.*

#### Inspiring Reproduction — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** While channeling 2 or more instrument abilities, allies within their range all gain your choice of the following on each of your turns: ● +2 EVA ● Heal 2 Strain ● Gain 2 THP (unstackable)

#### >> Appoint Champion — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triple the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments that affect a target ally until your next turn (does not stack with other multiplicative effects). That ally also gains 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until your next turn.

#### < Derail Retelling — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on you or an ally being hit by an attack by 4 or more points above EVA. The character that triggered this ability gains +8 EVA until your next turn and gains 1 temporary destiny point until the end of your next turn.

## Path: Discordant
*Offensive and disruptive path that applies consistent harm to groups of enemies.*

#### Revolting Reproduction — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** While channeling 2 or more instrument abilities, enemies within their range all suffer your choice of the following on each of your turns: ● Bleeding 1 (unstackable) ● Burn 1 (unstackable) ● -1 EVA

#### >> Visceral Performance — *Defensive*
Class *
**5 SN** · -4 EVA  
**Effect:** Triple the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments that affect enemies until your next turn (does not stack with other multiplicative effects).

#### >> Farewell Theme — *Ranged attack*
Class *
**10 SN** · +2 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Use a weapon to reduce yourself to 0 HP and become incapacitated. This attack targets and inflicts DMG on all enemies within your channeled abilities’ ranges equal to their combined Strain cost. Your channeled abilities remain channeled for 2 more turns after this ability is performed, and their effects double on each of those turns. You may suffer a failing instead of an injury for performing this attack.

sections.title: Envoy
sections.content:
# Envoy

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 94-97 -->  
**Archetype:** Guide · Orders · Prediction  
**Recommended disciplines:** Leadership  

> As he was being transported to the scene they briefed him on the situation, on the trapped family and the maniac who was about to burn down the building they were in. Before entering his assistant passed him a tiny pistol which he tucked away in his pocket. Entering the building, he could see naught but dim, dusty hallways and narrow passages. He pleaded with the beast for nearly an hour before finally snapping at the gruesome plan the beast had presented concerning the little girl. He initiated the brawl with the intent to deceive, and when the beast got tired and pulled out a knife he placed a single precise shot in its dome. This was the last time he would agree to participate in such a negotiation. He knew they were after him for a long while. There was no easy way to purge the force of the traitors, so his best idea was to set a trap. He organized every detail of the ambush himself, he set his allies up in the exact positions and gave them a precise timeline. He had thought of everything, and all that was left was to convince his opponents he had not. He placed himself into an exposed office with a single entryway and waited. When they found him he could barely even strike at them before they knocked him to the ground, stabbed him in the back and shot his hands. His allies would reach them in time and capture them for memory extraction, yet his body would forever bear the scars of his master plan. She looked solemnly over the battlefield-to-become, despairing at the little hope they had left. They had lost too many men already, and the upcoming battle was about to become the final nail in their collective coffin. In what might have been an erratic and delusional idea, she donned her old armour and marched herself to the frontlines below. She had led them into death for too long, and if she was to do so again she could not bear witness. She would be the one to lead them into doom, and if luck allowed it, she would give them the tiniest of surges before fading into nothingness. As she made her way to the line of death, she had one last conversation with each of her close friends, those who had given her their all. Standing on the final rampart, she would prepare her rhetoric routine for the final time, producing a form-perfect rallying speech before descending into the mayhem. When she was impaled, she mustered everything she had to give them a final, frozen smile. Envoys are diplomats and commanders well versed in negotiation tactics and leadership roles. They prefer to attempt a conversation before resorting to more primitive means of conflict resolution. While some envoys prefer to lead from the front and amongst their allies, others work best within the confines of their own minds and the safety of the backlines, driving their allies to perform unimaginable feats through rhetoric and poetry.

## Class Features
#### Tactical Engine — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may use any order ability for only 1 AP. If you do, you may not use additional order abilities that turn and you suffer 1 Strain for each order target who fails to complete the order.

#### >>> Grand Plan — *Utility*
Class *
**4 Strain**  
**Effect:** Perform any order ability at no AP cost and choose up to 5 targets for it. During your next turn, you may perform another order ability at no AP cost targeting those same targets. You suffer 1 Strain for each target who fails to complete the order and heal 8 Strain if all targets complete both orders.

#### | Fallback Option — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**6 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This ability costs 3 Strain less if an ally failed to complete one of your orders since your previous turn.

## Path: Paragon
*Path that leads by example and reaps the full benefits of inspiring their allies.*

#### Centerpiece — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may freely target yourself with orders you perform in addition to their regular targets. You cannot suffer SN for not completing your own order and the first order you assign to yourself while using Grand Plan is always counted as completed. For each ally who completes an order after you have done so, both you and that ally restore 1 Strain.

#### >> Moment of Celebration — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Usable only if all targets of your order and you have completed that order since your previous turn. Restore 4 Strain and gain 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of combat.

#### < Determined Execution — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on your ability that would complete your order failing. You may reroll that ability.

## Path: Martinet
*Path that specializes in backline strategy, pushing their allies to their limits.*

#### Mastermind — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever all targets of an order complete it, restore 2 SN and gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the encounter. You may spend destiny points to give AP to the targets of your orders with a limit of 1 AP per target per combat round.

#### >> Field Promotion — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Grant a willing ally 3 AP. They may use the same abilities twice during their turn and they suffer 4 SN.

#### < Disciplinary Action — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an allies’ ability that would complete your order failing. They may increase their roll by 1 per 2 SN they spend.

sections.title: Wayfarer
sections.content:
# Wayfarer

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 98-101 -->  
**Archetype:** Guide · Navigator · Elusive  
**Recommended disciplines:** Protection  

> He ran through the grassy field, both arrows and snow raining down on him. Left, right, left right - the arrows swooped by him, yet none would hit their mark. No matter the conditions, he would deliver the message today, and neither a force of man nor nature would interrupt him. This unending source of resolve was inspired by neither love nor sentimentality, but was a product of a life that knew no other purpose and no other duty. He would collapse before the city gates, bloodied, utterly exhausted and more than anything - alive. This was just another night of exchanging stories beneath the stars, and he was leading just another group of traders through a famously dangerous passage. One of them had lost their bag earlier, another one was mauled by a wild animal, another yet had picked up a wicked fever. He gave up some of his own rations to help out, he was jumping at the chance to treat the bite wounds and he immediately knew which herbs could help out with the illness. Sitting around the campfire with them now, for the first time since maybe ever, he felt compelled to tell them of his world and his thoughts. He really tried to enjoy himself, yet something within him would not shut up about even this group’s fleeting existence. She was well known for her knowledge of the area and would often lead groups of travellers through the mountains, making sure to avoid the more popular roads and the highwaymen that stalked them. Her blade led from the front, her crossbow protected those in the back. Sometimes the wildlife would successfully wound her companions, sometimes the terrain would break a few of their bones, but nobody save herself had ever perished on one of her expeditions. Wayfarers are scouts and explorers who spend their time navigating the wilderness. While some work as messengers, others act as guardians and rangers of various regions, offering aid to those in need and defending their lands against would-be threats. They prefer lighter weapons and armour that allows them to swiftly traverse various rough terrain. Their excellent navigation skills set them apart as invaluable allies in dangerous areas.

## Class Features
#### Experienced Guide — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever your ally rolls an Endurance, Perception or Survival check, you may also roll it and add +2 to their roll if you succeed. Allies moving towards you gain +1 tile of Movement speed.

#### >> Target Call — *Utility Command*
Class *
**3 Strain**  
**Effect:** Target creature is Marked. Abilities performed by you and your allies targeting the marked creature gain +2 DMG and cost 2 Strain less. The mark disappears the next time you use this ability.

#### >> Point Out — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 Strain** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Give yourself or an ally within your M +4 EVA until your next turn. You heal 4 Strain for each attack that misses them or you during this period.

## Path: Vanguard
*Path that strives to keep its allies alive in battle through various defensive tactics.*

#### Defiant Example — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you suffer DMG, choose an ally to gain that much TVG. Interacting with an ally is now a free action.

#### < Savior — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on ally getting damaged. If you can reach them with one movement action, you may move to them or you may gain +3 ACC on attacks targeting the creature that damaged them until the end of your next turn.

#### >> Vigil — *Defensive*
Class *
**4 SN** · +4 EVA  
**Effect:** You and your allies within your M gain +1 Tile of movement speed until your next turn. If any of them would perform a death save, you may spend 6 Strain in order for it to automatically succeed.

## Path: Courier
*A path focused on survivability and elusiveness.*

#### Hard Target — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you move twice in a turn, gain +2 EVA until your next turn. You gain +4 Burden capacity.

#### > Rapid Traversal — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain an additional Movement action. The next time you move this turn, gain +2 ACC and +2 DMG on your next attack if standing next to an enemy or +3 EVA if no enemies are within your A.

#### < Proximity Response — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on entering or leaving of A of an enemy. Inflict Stun 2. The target cannot move until the end of their next turn (CL 16 Stance Save).

The next time you move this turn, gain +2 ACC and +2 DMG on your next attack if standing next to an enemy or +3 EVA if no enemies are within your A. < Proximity Response — Melee/Ranged Attack Class  3 SN · +0 ACC · +1 DMG Effect: Triggers on entering or leaving of A of an enemy. Inflict Stun 2. The target cannot move until the end of their next turn (CL 16 Stance Save).

sections.title: Apothecary
sections.content:
# Apothecary

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 102-105 -->  
**Archetype:** Scholar · Concoctions · Toolbox  
**Recommended disciplines:** Shadow/Duel  

> An old woman sat in a dimly lit room behind a desk laid with flasks and bottles. She ground some herbs in a mortar before finally mixing them into a thick, greenish liquid that has been placed over a light flame for hours. She would later use it to create an intense incense to ward off the creatures of the night. She would sometimes catch herself dreaming of the world beyond the forest, of what she could have seen out there, though the familiar mantra would quickly pop up - “You leave, they die.” He was by all means slower, weaker and less experienced than his fellows. Yet his strength laid in something else entirely - in his various belts and pouches and vials that were stored in them. A single cut would be enough for his venom to be applied, sending the enemy into manic fear before inflaming their airways so much as to completely close them. His comrades would sometimes call his methods vile and barbaric, but he had struggled to understand how they were any worse than hacking someone up into tiny pieces or violently breaking their bodily vessel. This way he at least got to avoid the fatigue such prolonged, intense combat could often carry. His position was overrun by the invading force, yet he still had a patient to finish treating. The enemy did not expect much resistance from the medical tent, allowing himself to recklessly stride into it, taunting the medic. He even laughed when the medic tackled him to the ground, a tiny scalpel in his hand. The laughter stopped when he recalled an earlier operation, his patient’s chest purple and swelling. He recalled the exact, precise cut of the scalpel he had made that saved the patient, and applied it ruthlessly to do the exact opposite. Hands shaking and mind spinning, he quickly got up and returned to his patient. He would later berate himself not for taking a life, but for failing to regain composure to save another. Apothecaries are scientists and doctors. Their curious minds are naturally drawn to the study of concoctions, poisons and anatomy. Some may spend their days endlessly tinkering with potions and ingredients, creating wildly potent brews, while others yearn to apply their knowledge in order to ensure the survival of their fellows. Others yet see the knowledge they possess for what it truly is - a weapon most powerful and unknown to the uneducated masses.

## Class Features
#### Alchemist’s Bag — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You have access to a personal pouch of concoctions that don’t require ingredients to be prepared as long as you’re not trapped somewhere. Once per week, you may prepare 3 simple concoctions and 1 advanced concoction for that pouch. New concoctions take up the slots of existing ones.

#### >> Incision — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Choose one: Harm: Perform an attack with +2 ACC that inflicts Bleeding 1. Any poisons applied to your weapon deal +2 DMG this attack. Heal: Perform a Defensive action and a CL 14 Survival check on yourself or an adjacent ally to reduce the target’s Bleeding by 2. If at half or less of their maximum VG, they restore 3 VG.

#### >> Theorem Application — *Defensive Action*
Class *
**0 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Consume or apply a concoction to yourself or an ally. If you are at half or more of your SL, heal 5 SN.

## Path: Venomdrop
*Poison-oriented path that aims to maximize their effects while conserving doses.*

#### Durable Fangs — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Alchemist’s Bag gains a new slot for an advanced poison. Attacks you perform that exceed the target’s EVA score by 2 or more do not consume your weapon’s applied poison.

#### > Subject Observation — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +3 EVA against enemies who have been affected by your concoctions this turn until your next turn.

#### > Lethal Dose — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** The target of your next attack with a poisoned weapon suffers the effects of that poison again on their next turn.

## Path: Surgeon
*Supportive path aimed at keeping allies alive and utilizing concoctions to increase their performance.*

#### Battlefield Medic — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Alchemist’s Bag gains a new slot for an elixir. Utility actions that interact with allies are performed at Instant speed.

#### > Better Than New — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** The next time you would apply a concoction to an ally or successfully perform a survival check on them this turn they gain +2 ACC on their next attack and heal 2 VG and 2 SN.

#### > Overdose — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Apply two doses of one or more concoctions to yourself or an ally.

sections.title: Clairvoyant
sections.content:
# Clairvoyant

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 106-109 -->  
**Archetype:** Scholar · MemoryTheft · Prosthetics  
**Recommended disciplines:** Echo  

> The crime scene was already blocked off and detectives were swarming the premises - they were waiting for her. As she entered the dim tent, her eyes briefly scanned the room before settling on the dead body in the middle. She calmed her breathing and focused on her engraved ring, on the corpse. She felt the scene of death assemble before her and play out the exact moment the deceased cried out in fear and pain - the exact moment of his stabbing. All that was left was to sketch the face of the murderer and send it to print. His path to the vault was now blocked by only a single guard. He extended his metallic arm and calmed down. He entered his target’s memories and took a hold of the past few days. With a single snap of his fingers, he violently ripped them out, leaving behind a scattering husk of a man and a great migraine in the place his recent memories once occupied. Finally, he simply pushed the guard out of the way and proceeded to the vault. Later that day, in the safety of his hideout, he would delve into the memories he tore out. He would traverse the vignettes of workplace abuse, a crumbling family life, a lost love, culminating in that terrible, painful erasure. He felt horrible for the entire duration of 5 minutes it took for him to decide he would rather erase these memories entirely than deal with their ramifications. She sat atop the lookout tower in a bath of cool water. Her entire synthetic torso was flaring up from the effort she was putting out. She was rapidly scanning and analyzing the battlefield below, delving into each enemy’s memories, predicting their next moves and transmitting this information to her allies. She often felt more like a machine than a person, yet her efficiency was undisputed and she would rather that they find her melted metallic remnants than witness what they felt in their final moments. Clairvoyants are investigators and tacticians, utilizing ambedic artifacts and prosthetics to interact with and influence the memories of those around them. They are able to learn the fighting style of an opponent in mere seconds and can even rip memories out provided their equipment can handle it. Some clairvoyants will further opt into memory manipulation, making the process stronger and more damaging to the target’s mind while others may prefer to help out their allies through intense battlefield analysis and memory transmission, creating an almost instantaneous communication network.

## Class Features
#### Analytical Mind — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you Analyze a target, gain a choice of either +2 ACC or +2 EVA against them. The target stops being Analyzed when you Analyze a new target.

#### >> Memory Extraction — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack inflicts Stun and SN equal to the DMG it would deal and heals an equal amount of your SN. Must target an Analyzed target.

#### >> /> Overlord — *Defensive*
Class *
**2 SN** · -2 EVA  
**Effect:** Grant your buffs against Analyzed targets to any number of allies.

## Path: Thoughtripper
*A path that further intrudes on the minds of its targets, now dealing damage in addition to fracturing their will.*

#### Psyche Fracture — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Your Eidoloscope attacks now deal DMG in addition to their other effects and you inflict Fractured 1 on successful Eidoloscope attacks against Analyzed targets and .

#### > Known Weakness — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain the unchosen buff from Mind Glimpse in addition to the one you chose.

#### >>> Neural Shutdown — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**8 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Incapacitate a target (CL 16 Willpower Save). If the target resists the incapacitation, you take the DMG of the attack instead.

## Path: Echologue
*Fragile path that acts as tactical support, providing allies with insight into their enemies and potent combat advantages.*

#### Past Unraveled — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Analyzing a new target doesn’t remove the condition from your previous target.

#### | Predetermined Outcome — *Utility*
Class *
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, each roll against Analyzed targets performed by you or your allies restores you 1 SN. Only usable while at half or more of your SL.

#### >>> Safeguard Protocol — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · -4 EVA  
**Effect:** Lose any amount of HP. Your allies gain that much EVA until your next turn.
