sections.title: Mechanist
sections.content:
# Mechanist

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 110-113 -->  
**Archetype:** Scholar · Constructs · RemoteControl  
**Recommended disciplines:** Echo  

> It finally moved! She had been working on the little automaton for months, and she finally managed to get it to move. She was starting to get frustrated, not knowing whether it was the design of the motor and the legs or her ambedic link to the little machine that was at fault. For someone who was proud to exclaim that she would never mother a child, she sure seemed excited to witness her creation shift and shake, even if it ultimately was just a cold construct. He sat behind tall cover, a blindfold over his eyes. He used the first construct to plant a breach charge on the enemy’s wall. Once it blew open, the second construct flew into the building, equipped with a flamethrower and an oil spewing mechanism. Luckily, he had recently installed a transmission dampener onto his ambedic receiver in order to block out unnecessary emotions and increase his efficiency at piloting such a horrifying machine. After a few rounds of drinks, he was even able to forget the face of the child that was inside the building. She stood inside her construct-suit, placed in between the firing line and the wounded civilians behind her. Before charging into the gunmen she recalled how sad she felt when she disassembled her old construct so she could use its battery to power this monstrous suit. As the bullets rained upon her firm but still destructible shell, she could swear she heard it thank her. Mechanists are pioneers of robotics, assembling and piloting the very first of such creations. They combine their knowledge of mechanics and ambedic technology in order to create remotely-controllable extensions of their body in the form of robotic companions. Due to the great mental load operating such a construct demands, the very best of the mechanists can only ever optimally operate two smaller constructs or a single more complex one at any given moment.

## Class Features
#### Sensory Meld — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may suffer VG damage instead of Strain for performing Echo, Construct and Mechanist Class abilities.

#### | Overclock — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** A construct you are paired with gains +2 ACC, +1 DMG dealt and +1 Tile of movement until your next turn. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### < Breaking Point — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers upon construct having 0 or less HP or otherwise shutting down. Prevent the construct from shutting down until your next turn.

## Path: Operator
*Path that focuses on multitasking and control of multiple constructs.*

#### Mind Fragmentation — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You can be paired with two Constructs at the same time and you can perform two command abilities or perform the same command ability twice in a single turn provided they target two different Constructs. At the beginning of your turn you may lose your Movement action to gain 1 AP that can only be spent on command abilities targeting constructs.

#### >> Target Triangulation — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +3 ACC for each of your paired constructs within C of the target. After performing this ability, your allies gain the same ACC bonuses against that target until your next turn or until the constructs are no longer in the correct range.

#### < Bodily Extension — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy attack hitting you or an ally. If it was a melee attack, any construct you are paired with within your or your ally’s M may come to the target’s aid to a tile adjacent to them and redirect the attack to itself. If it was a ranged attack, any construct you are paired with within M of that attack’s trajectory may move into it and redirect the attack to itself.

## Path: Pilot
*Path that directly interfaces with its large construct mech, providing precise control over its actions.*

#### Load Dampening — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** The cost of regaining AP while piloting a mech costs you only 2 Strain per AP. You may regain the 4th AP in a turn that costs 4 Strain and requires a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the Mech suffers a Glitch.

#### < Subsystem Optimization — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on the start of your turn while you are piloting a Mech. You may eliminate the cooldown of your Mech’s subsystem. Make a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the Mech suffers a Glitch.

#### >>> Ambedic Pulse — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**10 SN** · 0 ACC · 2 DMG  
**Effect:** Disturb your mech’s power source, inflicting SN equal to your own SN to all creatures within M of the Mech. This attack cannot miss and cannot deal overflowing DMG. You are ejected from the Mech.

sections.title: Arbiter
sections.content:
# Arbiter

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 114-117 -->  
**Archetype:** Mystic · Gravity · Augury  
**Recommended disciplines:** Zeal, Mysticism  
**Recommended special skills:** Deception, Lore, Carry, Whisper  

> A man sits under the cloudy, silvery sky, his body still yet his eyes twitching wildly. In his thoughts, he is far above the valley, soaring through the cold heavens above. His wings click and shift, producing crisp, metallic sounds. He knows the storm is coming, so he flies southward to warn his kin. Landing on a predetermined signal pad, his fellow takes note, and the man disassociates from the avian construct. He breathes in a few times to acclimate to his surroundings before getting up and walking back into his home. They send her in only when they’re absolutely sure of the suspect’s identity and absolutely sure that they would be in danger to even attempt to confront them. She is silent like a flap of feathers in the night, her dark clothing blends into the shadows of buildings and trees alike. She cares not to make a scene, but to extract a swift confession and deliver a verdict should it be required. Most of them fold when she lifts their fragile body up to the ceiling or high in the air. Those who do not usually fold when she bends one of their limbs to encourage honesty. The remaining ones break completely when she is unsatisfied with their testimonies. Children, women and men alike hide from her when she walks down the street like she is some sort of boogeyman, yet she has learned not to pay them any mind. They’ve thought her a cold monster before she became cruel, so why should she deprive them of their fantasy? The creatures of the forest were rapidly descending upon the village, and most of its defenders had already been torn apart. It was never his job to eliminate threats, but to buy time either through repelling them or through acting as a bulwark to those who could not fight. This noble goal had been the thing that had kept him sane and focused for all these years, allowing him to claw back countless souls from the woodland’s malignant branches. Duty and life, one in the same to his peaceful mind, to abandon one would be to abandon both. He would call each and every crow in sight, arranging them in a cryptic flight pattern above the crumbling town. The creatures would begin to struggle with even the most basic movements under the omen and at the mercy of the flying, bloodthirsty knives swirling about. Once he was sure everyone had long departed, he would calm the storm and sit down. He would look at the dark sky one last time before breathing in, never to let go. Arbiters are the mystics of Trumst proficient in the control of gravitational forces and control of the omnipresent crow constructs of Dunyor. They serve the forces of reason and order, acting as surveyors and surveillance specialists, and if need be, potent group disruptors capable of misaligning the limbs of enemy combatants in precisely the right time at precisely the wrong place.

## Class Features
#### Eye of the Murder — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** At the beginning of your turn, you call a crow construct to your vicinity. Whenever you perform an attack, you may send out two crows to: Fracture: Inflict Fractured 1 on the target. Crows leave your vicinity upon being used by this ability.

#### > Unseen Aid — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst Call a nearby crow construct to your vicinity (that stays) to perform your choice of the following: Assist: Gain 1 AP that persists between rounds and does not count towards your default cap of 3 AP. Pinpoint: Move your MO. Shelter: Prevent the next instance of DMG you would receive and suffer twice as much SN instead.

#### >> Forcefield — *Defensive*
Class *
**3 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst Inflict Push 1 on all enemies standing in your A and all enemies who enter your A until the next turn and heal 1 Strain per inflicted Push. Enemies may only be affected by the second condition of this ability once per turn.

## Path: Inquisitor
*Path that fully prioritizes spatial control and mechanical force to suppress any obstacles it encounters.*

#### Subjugating Presence — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Status effects you inflict upon Intimidated enemies are increased by +1. Eye of The Murder gains the following option: Terrorize: inflict Intimidated which lasts until the target successfully attacks you instead of its usual duration.

#### >> Retribution — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst If the target attacked during their previous turn, inflict Feeble 2. If the target used a defensive ability during their previous turn, inflict Bleeding 2. If the target used a utility ability, inflict Stun 2.

#### | Grand Authority — *Utility*
Class *
**8 SN**

He knows the storm is coming, so he flies southward to warn his kin. Landing on a predetermined signal pad, his fellow takes note, and the man disassociates from the avian construct. He breathes in a few times to acclimate to his surroundings before getting up and walking back into his home. They send her in only when they’re absolutely sure of the suspect’s identity and absolutely sure that they would be in danger to even attempt to confront them. She is silent like a flap of feathers in the night, her dark clothing blends into the shadows of buildings and trees alike. She cares not to make a scene, but to extract a swift confession and deliver a verdict should it be required. Most of them fold when she lifts their fragile body up to the ceiling or high in the air. # Empath

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 118-121 -->  
**Archetype:** Mystic · Strain · Divination  
**Recommended disciplines:** Zeal/Mysticism  

> After a battle would end, she would arrive. To tend to the survivors’ wounds, but more importantly to their souls. No matter the side, no matter the goal, no matter the thanks, she would comfort each and every living and dying soul, easing their mental toll and letting them return to their regular lives. She would take in all of this pain and dissolve it within herself, becoming a tiny bit more hollow each time, becoming a tiny bit more capable each time, becoming a tiny bit more nobody each time. He knew of both the dangers and boons of the planar edge. He’d spent his life studying it, wandering the void in between, in search of things forgotten and things yet to be learned. By the time they accused him of dark magic he was already long gone from the town. By the time the brigands shot at him he was already prepared to dodge each and every arrow sent his way in an arrangement of movements no human could ever attempt. By the time the axe split his head, he had already long made peace with his inevitable fate. Armed with naught but a walking stick, she barged into the target’s house. The coward tried to ambush her, yet his arms flickered and his sword fell through them to the ground. “Did you murder them?” - she asked in an unfeeling tone. Before the accused could even open his mouth, his mind had already betrayed him, spilling out all that went through it. Satisfied with the answer, she declared her judgement. The coward’s body slumped to the ground, his mind detaching from the person, aimlessly staring at the floor. In but a minute the coward would flicker away for the last time, disappearing not just from reality but from the minds of those who knew him. She never felt bad about what she had to do, in part because she thought oblivion preferable to corporeal punishment, in part because her memory of them would soon expire. Empaths are diviners and telepaths capable of previewing the thoughts and emotions of living creatures as well as severely dampening them. Some empaths fully dedicate themselves to interpretation of creatures and are able to predict their actions in advance while others prefer to hone their ability to disrupt the stream of consciousness, becoming capable of fully erasing living beings from existence. While these abilities are powerful, empaths are often limited in their use due to their devotion to the ideals of Bruma, making them possibly the least destructive type of mystic.

## Class Features
#### Laid Bare — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** At the beginning of your turn in combat you may choose a creature with PSY equal to or lower than yours. You learn the actions that will be performed by the chosen creature during their next turn.

#### >> Vast Soul — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Heal SN equal to your class rank plus your highest Bruma conviction rank. An ally you can see gains +EVA equal to your class rank. Only usable at half or more of your maximum SL.

#### < Ephemera — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Triggers on enemy performing an action in combat that requires a roll. You may reduce the roll by 2.

## Path: Prophet
*A path that emphasizes the connection to the planar void and the sudden bursts of knowledge it bestows upon its acolytes.*

#### Fate Foretold — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Once per day, you may roll 3d6 and note down the result. During that day, you may replace any roll you witness with the noted result.

#### > Predetermination — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma If one exists, give the target of an ability predicted through Laid Bare +2 EVA against that attack.

#### | Fate Rejected — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Activate after any roll. Increase a failing by 2 ranks or gain a new failing at rank 2. You gain a number of temporary destiny points equal to your DP maximum that can be spent in any way on that roll. Those destiny points disappear after the roll.

## Path: Specter
*A path that focuses on erasure of consciousness and Strain manipulation.*

#### Void Brand — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Whenever you inflict SN upon a creature, that creature becomes Branded until the end of combat or for 2 hours outside of combat. You gain +2 on all PSY and Bruma ability rolls against Branded creatures.

#### >> Self Implosion — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**+0 SN** · +0 ACC  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma The target’s non-defensive abilities cost +2 SN until your next turn (CL 15 Willpower Save). While this effect persists, the target suffers DMG equal to the SN it inflicts upon itself via ability usage.

#### >> Annul — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Target creature suffers DMG equal to their current SN (CL 15 Willpower save).

# Sorcerer

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 122-125 -->  
**Archetype:** Mystic · Wildfire · SelfBurn  
**Recommended disciplines:** Zeal/Mysticism  
**Recommended special skills:** Medicine, Discipline, Whisper, Authority  

> His parents woke him and his sister up in the middle of the night in a panicked hurry. They barely had time to dress before they were dragged out of their house and into the dark woods, alone. As they ran they could hear screams behind them and see a pyre where their home once stood. After hours of travel they collapsed in a secluded den, holding hands as they shook from the cold. He berated himself for not bringing a lighter, matches, anything to keep the cold at bay. At some point during the night their hands lit ablaze. When they woke up in the forest with their oil and torches gone they thought they wouldn’t last a day longer. Their scorchblades could provide them some light, yes, but not enough to weather the endless nights. It was precisely in the moment where they stood surrounded with cold, burnt out blades in their hands that she ignited. She would give her flesh to be their beacon in the final stand. As fire spread throughout her, their blades ignited once more and even began to spew fire on the beasts assaulting them. The miracle of her charred flesh gave them time, but more importantly it gave them hope. What remained of her body was brought back to the city and placed in a casket on a public square where she would forever watch over the central pyre. Throughout the night he stood on the castle tower bombarding the battlements below with fire fueled by his flesh. The sparks flew and jumped as if they had a will of their own, spreading through the enemy forces almost like a bolt of lightning. Throughout the night he saw many of his friends fall and the parts of the various halls he walked now bloodied and ravaged. Throughout the night he treated his flesh and did all in his power to stop it from fully burning out, yet his body was nearing its limit. The final nail was not that he lacked the will to die for the cause or that he had no body left to burn. The final blow was the realization that his sacrifice here never even mattered, that no matter his power he would never have been able to protect them. His fire was finally snuffed out, and his half intact body collapsed on the floor, not sure what to even think about in its final moments. Sorcerers are powerful channelers of flame capable of igniting their flesh and controlling the fire this produces. They excel at ravaging hordes of fleshy beings, though with more precision they can also act as supportive leaders who provide their allies with lit weaponry, cauterize their wounds as they appear and light the paths they walk. All of this is paid for in full by their bodies as their flesh degrades from repeated burns, leaving them marked by their devotion to Vamor.

## Class Features
#### Beacon of Sacrifice — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may suffer SN instead of VG damage inflicted by Soulburn. Reaching Soulburn 5 grants you a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the encounter, once per combat encounter.

#### >> Engine of Consumption — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor You do not suffer Soulburn DMG during your next turn. Choose any option an amount of times equal to your Soulburn rank: Spark: Inflict Burn 1 on a target within your C. Soothe: Heal 1 SN to a target ally within your C.

#### > Flaming Rebirth — *Utility*
Class *
**0 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Restore 8 SN as long as your SN is at half or above your SL max. You suffer Fractured 1 until the end of your next turn and Feeble 2 until the end of the turn following that one.

## Path: Arsonist
*Path that removes all safeguards and fully immerses itself in the wildfires it creates.*

#### Blazing Artillery — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Engine of Consumption costs you only 1 AP to perform and its Spark option has a range of M and it no longer freezes the Soulburn DMG during your next turn. Witnessing an enemy be incapacitated by a Vamor ability or Burn restores 2 VG and 2 SN to you.

#### > Ignition — *Utility*
Class *
**0 Strain**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Spend any amount of SN to suffer that much Soulburn. If you spend SN this way, gain +2 EVA until your next turn.

#### | Wildfire — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Take another turn after this one. Usable only if your Soulburn is at rank 6 or higher. Costs 1 Destiny Point per use beyond the first in a combat encounter.

## Path: Pyreon
*A path that empowers those who would witness it, using flames to elevate their allies in various ways.*

#### Example Eternal — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Engine of Consumption’s Soothe option has a range of M. Vamor Mysticism abilities you perform that target only you may be used on up to 3 total targets within your M whenever you perform them. Whenever you witness an ally under the influence of your Vamor Mysticism abilities incapacitate an enemy, restore 2 VG and 2 SN.

#### >> Heat Redistribution — *Defensive*
Class *
**6 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Heal an amount of VG equal to your Soulburn rank distributed amongst any number of allies within your C. You may spend a Destiny Point while performing this ability to extend the range to M and double the VG available. ●

#### < Inner Persistance — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Triggers on you suffering DMG. Instead of taking that DMG, suffer that much Soulburn instead.

sections.title: Witch
sections.content:
# Witch

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 126-129 -->  
**Archetype:** Mystic · Fleshweaving · Reanimation  
**Recommended disciplines:** Zeal/Mysticism  

> She burst into the dimly lit cellar with only a purple flower in hand. On a central table there was a beggar, his leg amputated in order to evoke more pity from the passersby. Around him, two grotesque figures stood, instruments of pain in hand and grimaces in place of what would be their faces. She took a whiff of the flower and attuned to the torturer’s bodies, analysing their bones and muscles. Seconds later, they would fall to the ground, puke erupting from their orifices, blood trickling from their flayed skin. All that was left to restore the balance was to mend the beggar’s appendage back where it belonged. The winter after her husband’s death had almost killed her. Isolated in that forest, she could barely sustain herself on berries and the pitiful produce of her garden. In desperation, she turned to her late husband’s study in search of a solution. While she was shocked to learn of the true nature of his research, it would prove to be her salvation. She exhumed his corpse and raised a revenant of flesh, just like his journal had explained. With tears in her eyes and peace in her heart, she would order “it” to hunt. They all hated him and they all relied on him to survive. He began to wonder if his presence had made his comrades’ instincts duller, their recklessness worse. They would break formation to assault beasts head on, knowing he would quickly reattach any appendage or organ they lost. They charged into fire fully expecting him to regrow their skin once the dust had settled. He was a useful freak, a monster capable of unmaking or remaking life, but a freak they could no longer function without. Witches are occult healers and mediums versed in the arts of fleshweaving and necromancy. Some witches place a greater importance on manipulation of flesh and the living, acting as potent grafters or inflicting great harm upon skin and bone. Other witches work to perfect their mastery and control over the dead, being able to temporarily or permanently recall souls into their decaying bodies and bend their actions to their will. Due to their devotion to Halice, witches are often radical individuals bent on shaping the world into a new form. Even the corpses of those who opposed them will rise again to serve those ideals.

## Class Features
#### Rhythm of Life — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** When performing a Survival or Medicine check on a creature, you may gain Strain to increase your result by that much up to a maximum of +2. Halice abilities that require Attunement can be performed without it and apply it to their targets after being performed.

#### >> Fleshbound Hex — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 targets within your Attunement network, remove them from the network and inflict one of the following upon them: Flay Skin: Inflict Bleeding 2. Grind Bones: Inflict Stun 2. The target cannot move until the end of their next turn (CL 18 Stance save). Spoil Humors: Inflict Feeble 2. The target suffers +1 DMG from all sources until the end of your next turn.

#### >> Emergency Binding — *Defensive*
Class *
**4 SN** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice Target yourself or an ally. The target restores VG equal to the VG they lost since their previous turn +1. Each consecutive use of this ability also inflicts Bleeding equal to the number of times the ability has been used.

## Path: Occultist
*A path that ventures further into precise flesh manipulation, providing potent wards to allies and devastating curses to its enemies.*

#### Flesh Ward — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Allies within your Attunement network gain 2 TVG whenever you perform Fleshbound Hex. You may perform Vital attunement at only 1 AP cost by suffering 3 SN.

#### < Flaying Snare — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an ally within your Attunement network being damaged. The attacker is added to your Attunement network and they suffer Bleeding 2.

#### | Sensory Overload — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 8 creatures. They are considered a part of your Attunement network until the end of your turn.

## Path: Necromancer
*A path that empowers the reanimated dead and utilizes corpses in gruesome ways.*

#### Repurposed Servants — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may control up to two Zombies at the same time. Zombies you control do not suffer ACC penalties from being reanimated.

#### > Splinter Spider — *Utility*
Class *
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Target a Zombie you control that’s next to an enemy target and has full AP. The Zombie latches onto the target (CL 16 Stance Save) and, if the target fails to resist them, uses their ribcage and other available bones as a makeshift bear trap, performing a +0 ACC 4 DMG attack that cannot miss and inflicts Bleeding 3.

#### >> Sack Rapture — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**3 SN** · +2 ACC · +3 DMG  
**Effect:** Must target a corpse. This attack affects the C range of the corpse. The corpse explodes, inflicting Push 1, Fractured 2 and Stun 2 on those caught within the blast.
sections.searchText: Witch Archetype: Mystic · Fleshweaving · Reanimation Recommended disciplines: Zeal/Mysticism She burst into the dimly lit cellar with only a purple flower in hand. On a central table there was a beggar, his leg amputated in order to evoke more pity from the passersby. Around him, two grotesque figures stood, instruments of pain in hand and grimaces in place of what would be their faces. She took a whiff of the flower and attuned to the torturer’s bodies, analysing their bones and muscles. Seconds later, they would fall to the ground, puke erupting from their orifices, blood trickling from their flayed skin. All that was left to restore the balance was to mend the beggar’s appendage back where it belonged. The winter after her husband’s death had almost killed her. Isolated in that forest, she could barely sustain herself on berries and the pitiful produce of her garden. In desperation, she turned to her late husband’s study in search of a solution. While she was shocked to learn of the true nature of his research, it would prove to be her salvation. She exhumed his corpse and raised a revenant of flesh, just like his journal had explained. With tears in her eyes and peace in her heart, she would order “it” to hunt. They all hated him and they all relied on him to survive. He began to wonder if his presence had made his comrades’ instincts duller, their recklessness worse. They would break formation to assault beasts head on, knowing he would quickly reattach any appendage or organ they lost. They charged into fire fully expecting him to regrow their skin once the dust had settled. He was a useful freak, a monster capable of unmaking or remaking life, but a freak they could no longer function without. Witches are occult healers and mediums versed in the arts of fleshweaving and necromancy. Some witches place a greater importance on manipulation of flesh and the living, acting as potent grafters or inflicting great harm upon skin and bone. Other witches work to perfect their mastery and control over the dead, being able to temporarily or permanently recall souls into their decaying bodies and bend their actions to their will. Due to their devotion to Halice, witches are often radical individuals bent on shaping the world into a new form. Even the corpses of those who opposed them will rise again to serve those ideals. Fleshbound Hex — Utility Class  4 SN Effect: Target up to 3 targets within your Attunement network, remove them from the network and inflict one of the following upon them: Flay Skin: Inflict Bleeding 2. sections.content:
# Protean

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 130-133 -->  
**Archetype:** Aberration · Shapeshifter · Incoherent  
**Recommended disciplines:** Beast  

> With his sister’s death he was left truly and utterly alone. His days blended together into a single foggy timeline as he aimlessly wandered the city’s streets. Nobody was left to give him tasks, nobody was left to scold him, nobody was left to hold him while he slept on the cold cobblestone. In this dreamy state he would often imagine himself a stray cat, jumping about the various windows and poles of the metropolis. In this dreamy state, a maddened drunk would kick in his fragile, feline ribs. She had run out of pages in her journal. What was supposed to be a routine scouting expedition turned into months of lost wandering through the ever shifting and unfamiliar landscapes. She hadn’t even noticed the second pair of legs she grew when the feet of her old legs scraped off. She barely even registered that she could see everything around her using the new eyes that appeared on the sides of her head. When she miraculously returned to the planar edge, she realized she could not remember why she was searching for it to begin with. His lover’s death had made him a recluse. He wept day and night without pause, his mind dwelling on her image, on her mangled body. He cried thinking about how she must have felt in her final moments. Those who attempted to visit him would be scared away by the apparition of the late lover that dwelled within the apartment, that he had come to fully embody. His bloody tears would leave his body drop by drop, until nothing remained of him but a reddish stain on the bedroom floor. Proteans are shapeshifters who have been alienated from reality through intense psychological trauma or isolation. Their material form is unstable and they can easily manifest their imagination in the space surrounding them. Most people find them disturbing to interact with due to their often grotesque features and tendencies to mimic the forms of other people. If left unchecked for too long, they can easily get fully lost inside of their minds and completely disappear.

## Class Features
#### Dissociative Self — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You forgo the destiny point cost of the Beast discipline abilities. You may not raise a Conviction to a rank beyond 1 and you may not spend destiny points to add Conviction bonuses to rolls. If you reach a point where you have 3 Failings at rank 4, you will completely destabilize, get lost within your own unreality and disappear. If you reach a point where you have no more Failings, you will be cured of this condition. In addition to other costs, in order to reduce a Failing to rank 0 you must also spend 7 XP or reduce your skills to make up for the cost. When you get rid of your condition, your memories and body revert to the state they were in before you were afflicted. Your life as a protean remains in your mind as nothing but a painful, long and hazy daydream.

#### | Selfscape — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Spend 1 Destiny Point to perform this ability or increase one of your Failings by 1 rank. Gain 3 AP and an additional reaction until your next turn. The AP gained this way may only be spent on Beast and Protean abilities.

#### >> Manifest Delusion — *Defensive*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** If you are not damaged until your next turn, heal 8 SN down to half of your max SL. Otherwise, gain 3 temporary destiny points that last until the end of the combat encounter and increase one of your Failings by 1 rank.

## Path: Changeling
*Path that fully utilizes its manifestation powers to warp its body into a terrifying and flexible tool.*

#### Entropic Being — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Abilities your perform cost 1 Strain less. Manifest Flesh and Manifest Matter last until the end of the combat encounter. You lose one of the body parts or items gained from them every time you suffer 3 or more DMG in a single attack.

#### < Imagined Flesh — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy attack dealing 3 or more DMG to you. Choose: Sacrifice: Destroy one of your manifested body parts to completely negate the DMG of the attack. Retaliate: Perform an immediate +2 ACC +0 DMG attack that inflicts Fractured 1 on the enemy who triggered this reaction.

#### >>> Lifeline — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +4 EVA  
**Effect:** Costs a number of destiny points equal to your DP maximum to perform. Destroy all of your manifested body parts and items and heal 2 VG and 2 SN for each of them. Reduce one of your Failings by 1 rank.

## Path: Mimic
*Path that perfects precise visual manipulation in order to mimic other creatures.*

#### Surrogate Identity — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** When performing any kind of social roll, you may suffer up to 3 SN to gain an equal bonus for that roll. Manifest Flesh may be cast using 1 Destiny Point in order to completely change your appearance to match that of a known creature instead of its other effects.

#### | Miserable Puppet — *Utility*
Class *
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** The creature you are taking the appearance of that is witnessing you suffers Strain whenever you suffer strain or DMG until your next turn.

#### >>> Cling to Reality — *Defensive*
Class *
**0 SN** · +4 EVA  
**Effect:** Costs a number of destiny points equal to your DP maximum to perform. Abandon your disguise and lose the ability to change your appearance for 4 weeks. Reduce one of your Failings by 2 ranks.

sections.title: Vessel
sections.content:
# Vessel

<!-- chapter: 05-classes | pages: 134-137 -->  
**Archetype:** Aberration · Parasite · BloodManipulation  
**Recommended disciplines:** Beast  

> Her appetite wasn’t the same ever since the incident in the forest. In the span of a single day she had developed insomnia, her skin had begun to shed in places, and she couldn’t stand the smell of the blooming lilies. That first night she had been turning in her bed for hours, unable to even close her eyes. The pulsating tumor in her back writhed in pain, worming around her spine. It slithered up and down, massaging the fragile linchpin of her locomotive capabilities. After hours of adjustments, it would finally carve out its spot alongside it, making itself at home. It even promised to let her rest once she fed it. The lowlives had finished their drinks and it was time for them to find some entertainment. The stranger resting on a nearby lamp was chosen as the night’s victim and they moved to surround him. He spoke not a word as one of them punched him in the face, sending a stream of blood down his nose. The stranger could only smile as the attacker fell down to his knees, screaming, clenching his blood-covered and newly melted hand. For her next act she would demonstrate her mastery of hemomancy. A fattened pig was brought onto the stage and cut with a single slash of a scalpel. This was all she would need to work her magic. She steadied her breathing and her pupils dilated as she focused, opening the tiny cut into a gaping wound before finally bursting the intestines of the poor creature, leaving only a pale corpse surrounded by a dark red pool. Between the audience’s cheers and her wicked grin, you could barely tell who was having more fun. Vessels are hosts to vampiric parasites who are granted immense power over blood. In order to remain alive and avoid being consumed by the parasitic worm, they must regularly take toxins to pacify it. While some vessels cannot resist the temptation of power and allow the parasite to grow in order to further it, others will instead double down on the pacification of the creature and force it into submission, allowing them more precise control over their powers.

## Class Features
#### Vampiric Parasite — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** The Vessel exists in a constant state of struggle against its patron and intruder, suffering a permanent Conviction as long as they have this condition: Hunger: I will feast on the blood of the recently deceased. This Conviction must be fulfilled within a week of suffering a Crisis or it will trigger another Crisis. Fulfilling it grants the Vessel 1 Destiny Point and increases the rank of Hunger. Ingesting herbal poisons lowers the rank of Hunger by 1 rank but inflicts a -20% maximum VG and SN penalty, rounded up, for two weeks. If Hunger would increase beyond the maximum rank, the Vessel is fully overtaken by the parasite and it fully consumes their body. A surgery may be performed once Hunger is at rank 0 to remove the parasite (CL 22 Medicine). The Vessel heals VG equal to their class rank on all hemomancy attacks that inflict Bleeding.

#### >> Crimson Rain — *Ranged Attack*
Class *
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · -2 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack may target up to 3 targets who are already bleeding. Inflict Bleeding 2.

#### >> Sate Hunger — *Utility*
Class *
**0 SN**  
**Effect:** Must target a corpse, a willing or an unaware creature and may only be used once per target. Restore 5 VG and 5 SN and deal 10 DMG to the target if it’s a living creature.

## Path: Veincaller
*Path that fully embraces the parasite, increasing the potency of hemomancy.*

#### Unquenchable Thirst — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** Hunger extends to overtake another of your Conviction slots and is treated as having 8 ranks. Ingesting herbal poisons now inflicts a -50% maximum VG and SN penalty, rounded up, for one week. While at less than half of your maximum VG, your hemomancy attacks deal +1 DMG and inflict Bleeding 1.

#### > Violent Urge — *Utility*
Class *
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Lose half of your maximum VG, rounded up. Your next hemomancy attack inflicts Bleeding 2.

#### >>> Bleed Dry — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
Class *
**6 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** If this attack kills the target, gain TVG equal to their maximum VG. Your total of VG and TVGgained this way may not exceed your maximum VG.

## Path: Symbiote
*Path that pacifies the parasite, allowing for less destructive uses of hemomancy at the expense of offensive power. Path Passive Ability:*

#### Parasite Pacification — *Passive*
Class *
**Effect:** You may choose not to inflict DMG with your hemomancy attacks and cleanse Bleeding equal to its level that would usually be inflicted by the attack. Your hemomancy attacks deal -1 DMG and the Bleeding they inflict to enemies is reduced by 1. You no longer suffer VG and SN penalties from drinking herbal poisons.

#### >> Vascular Pulse — *Defensive*
Class *
**3 SN** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 2 to any number of targets inside M or closer. Targets affected by Bleeding suffer additional Stun equal to its level.

#### < Rapid Coagulation — *Utility*
Class *
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on you or ally within M being afflicted by Bleeding. Reduce the level of that effect by 2.

sections.title: Available Disciplines (Overview)
sections.content:
# Available Disciplines (Overview)

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 138-138 -->

CH VI. Disciplines
This chapter contains the list of all disciplines and their abilities. While classes tend
to greatly benefit from one or two disciplines, you should also consider how more
obscure discipline choices could modify and specialize your powers. A warden
could use halice mysticism to reanimate their enemies and have a whole band of
expendable meatshields. A rogue could utilize trumst mysticism’s crows to survey
areas before infiltrating them in person. An envoy could adopt the knowledge of
echo to get a better read on their allies. A vessel could make great use of precision
abilities to initially wound their victims. There are countless possible and viable
combinations of classes and disciplines to be explored and exploited.
Available Disciplines
There are a total of 10 unique disciplines to choose from:
● Warfare - Slay your foes mercilessly, take their blows head on
● Duel - Create openings, humiliate the enemy
● Protection - Become invulnerable, protect the innocent
● Leadership - Inspire comrades, push them to their limits
● Shadow - Strike unseen, win by any means
● Precision - Eliminate from afar, oversee the battlefield
● Echo - Exploit the past, animate constructs
● Zeal - Profess your convictions, evoke your Season.
● Mysticism - Ponder your ideals, reshape the world.
● Beast - Abandon self, unleash nightmares

# Warfare

**Slay your foes mercilessly, take their blows head on.**

#### >> Leg Sweep — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Blunt, Polearm*
**5 Strain** · +0 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Knock up to two targets Prone (CL 14 Stance save).

#### >> Stand Tall — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**0 Strain** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Gain 3 TVG. You gain +4 on Stance saves until your next turn.

#### < Overpower — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 Strain**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy melee attack not hitting you. Inflict Stun 1 on the target and gain +2 DMG against that target until the end of your next turn.

#### < No Quarter — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 Strain** · +2 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy leaving your A. Gain an additional movement action that must be used to enter A with that enemy after which you perform this attack.

#### >> Execution — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**6 Strain** · -6 ACC · +10 DMG  
**Effect:** For each status effect among Stun, Prone and Unaware affecting the target, this attack gains +3 ACC.

#### >> Dismember — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Axe, Sword*
**7 Strain** · -2 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** If the target has Bleeding higher than 3, this attack deals +8 DMG and dismembers any of their body parts.

#### >> Impale — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Polearm, Sword*
**7 Strain** · +2 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Gain an additional movement action. Inflict Pierce 3. This attack deals +2 DMG for each tile of distance between you and your target at the start of your turn.

#### >> Shatter Ego — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Blunt, Polearm*
**7 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 5, Push 2, knock the target Prone and Disarm them (combined CL 16 Stance save).

#### >> Internal Bleeding — *2H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Axe, Blunt*
**7 Strain** · +0 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Break 3. The target suffers Bleeding equal to the amount of armour points broken by this attack whenever it receives damage up to a total of Bleeding 6 until the end of your next turn.

sections.title: Duel
sections.content:
# Duel

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 142-144 -->  
**Create openings, humiliate your enemies.**  
*Recommended for nimble fighters, adventurers and those using light melee weapons.*  

## Abilities

#### >> Precise Strike — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Pierce 1.

#### >> Wicked Hack — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Axe*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · -2 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Bleeding 1.

#### >> Swift Slashes — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Sword, Polearm*
**0 SN** · -1 ACC · -1 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack is repeated once.

#### >> Concussive Blow — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Blunt*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 1.

#### < Flick — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing. If the target missed you by 4 or more, regain your reaction for the turn.

#### > Sidearm Holster — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Holster a melee weapon or shield. Gain +1 EVA until your next turn.

#### >> Meditate — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**0 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Heal 2 Strain for each enemy standing in your A.

#### > Exploitation — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Your next attack 1H melee attack this turn gains your choice of the following on stunned targets: ● Bleeding 1 ● Break 1 ● Pierce 2

#### > Destabilize — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 1.

#### >> Maiming Slash — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Axe, Sword, Polearm*
**4 SN** · -4 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Bleeding 2. The target loses their next movement action. Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

#### >> Disarming Strike — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Blunt, Sword, Polearm*
**4 SN** · -4 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** The target is Disarmed (CL 16 Stance save). Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

#### >> Brutal Swing — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Axe, Blunt*
**4 SN** · -4 ACC · +4 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Pierce 2. Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

#### < Perfect Parry — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing. Gain +1 AP on your next turn.

#### < Riposte — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 Strain** · +0 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy attack targeting you.

#### > Kick Down — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · 1 DMG  
**Effect:** If the target is stunned, knock them Prone (CL 14 Stance save). Otherwise, this attack inflicts Stun 2 or Stun 4 if the target used a defensive action during their previous turn.

#### > Issue Challenge — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Target an enemy within your A. Inflict Taunt on that enemy and gain +1 ACC against them for as long as they remain taunted.

#### >> Toppling Sequence — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**2 SN** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** Until the end of your next two turns, your attacks inflict Stun 2.

#### >> Dual Offensive — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** If you are holding two weapons, you may make an additional ranged throw attack with +2 ACC and +1 DMG with no action cost with one of them.

#### < Error of Their Ways — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +8 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing by 4 or more.

#### >> Honorable End — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · -5 ACC · +10 DMG  
**Effect:** Gains +1 ACC per successful attack you have made against the target in this combat encounter. May only be used once per enemy during that combat encounter

sections.title: Protection
sections.content:
# Protection

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 145-148 -->  
**Become invulnerable, protect the innocent.**  
*Recommended for heavy armour users, evasive scoundrels and those hoping to avoid death.*  

## Abilities

#### > Evasive Footwork — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +1 EVA until your next turn.

#### > On Guard — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**3 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain 3 TVG that last until your next turn.

#### >> Block — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Shield*
**0 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Restore 1 AP of your shield.

#### >> Shielded Attack — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Shield*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Gains +ACC equal to the sum of armour points and EVA provided by the shield.

#### > Shield Bash — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · 2 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 1.

#### >> Impervious — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**0 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Heal 2 SN for each attack made against you and each attack that does no DMG to you until your next turn. Only heals SN while at half or less of SL.

#### >> Elusive Target — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Gain EVA equal to your Dexterity/2, rounded down until the end of your turn.

#### >> Durable Target — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Your AP are increased by your Endurance/2, rounded down until the end of your turn.

#### >> Unpredictable Navigation — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**3 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Gain +2 tiles of movement on your next movement action. Not usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

#### >> Fortress — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Shield*
**3 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** You and an ally are treated as standing in cover one level higher until your next turn for as long as you are adjacent.

#### > Field Fortification — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**5 SN**  
**Effect:** Restore 1 AP. You may restore an AP and gain +2 EVA until your next turn if you spend +1 ACP to perform this ability. Not usable without worn armour or a shield that provides AP.

#### >> Slip Out — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** You cannot be targeted by attackers who haven’t attacked you since your last turn until your next turn. You cannot use this ability on consecutive turns. Not usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

#### < Intervention — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on adjacent enemy attempting to perform an average or slower action. If you have a higher or equal REF, prevent that action.

#### < Safeguard — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an ally adjacent to you being hit by an attack. You may redirect that attack to yourself.

#### >> High Stance — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Shield, 2H Melee Weapon*
**3 SN** · +4 EVA  
**Effect:** Bleeding, Stun and Break you suffer until your next turn are reduced by 3. Taunt a target enemy (CL 14 Willpower save).

#### < Damage Control — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an attack dealing DMG to you. Prevent up to half of that DMG rounded down after accounting for armour. This ability is only usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

#### >> Steel Shepard — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** All attacks targeting allies standing within C of you are redirected to you as long as you are adjacent to the attackers or standing between the attackers and your allies.

#### < Split-Second Slip — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy projectile attack targeting you. Gain +4 EVA against that attack. Unusable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

#### >> The Stand — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · +3 EVA  
**Effect:** Until your next turn you gain a free reaction melee attack every time an enemy enters your A that has +0 ACC and +0 DMG (This attack does not consume your reaction for the turn).

#### >> Shielded Charge — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Shield*
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Perform a movement action going in a straight line while performing this attack. This attack is made against all targets standing inside the line of movement and the targets are pushed to the sides as they are hit. This attack gains +ACC equal to the sum of armour points and EVA provided by the shield. Lose all shield benefits until your next turn.

sections.title: Leadership
sections.content:
# Leadership

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 149-152 -->  
**Inspire comrades, push them to their limits.**  
*Recommended for officers, activists and all who aim to coordinate their allies.*  

## Abilities

#### < Inspire — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on any allied roll and costs 1 ACP. Make an Intuition check with a CL equal to that roll and add +2 to the target roll if you succeed.

#### >> Stand Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies. If they use a melee attack during their next turn, they gain +3 EVA for 1 turn.

#### > Amplify — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Double the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments until your next turn.

#### >> /> Combat March — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Instrument*
**1/1 SN**  
**Effect:** Allies within your M gain +1 ACC.

#### >> Volley Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies. If they don’t use an attack during their next turn, they gain +3 ACC and +2 DMG on their next ranged attack and it costs 1 SN less to perform.

#### >> Strike Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies. During their next turn, their melee attacks may cost 2 less SN to perform and gain +2 ACC. If they do, any enemies flanking them deal +DMG equal to the ACC bonus from flanking to them until the end of their next turn.

#### >> />> Focused Melody — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Instrument*
**2/1 SN**  
**Effect:** Allies within your M gain +3 on all non-combat rolls. Also costs 1 destiny point to upkeep.

#### >> /> Echoing Elegy — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Instrument*
**2/1 SN**  
**Effect:** Enemies within your M suffer 2 SN per round.

#### >> Fallback Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies. If they move away from their closest enemy during their next turn they gain +1 Tile of movement during that movement action and gain +4 EVA until the end of their next turn.

#### >> Conservation Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies. If they don’t use any abilities with a SN cost during their next turn they heal 4 SN up to half of their SL at the end of that turn.

#### >> />> Alluring Aria — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Instrument*
**1/1 SN**  
**Effect:** Inflict Pull 1 to enemies within your M and Stun 1 to enemies within your C per round.

#### >> />> Radiant Resonance — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Instrument*
**2/2 SN**  
**Effect:** Inflict Push 1 to enemies within your M and Burn 2 to enemies within your C per round.

#### >> Pinpoint Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies and an enemy. If all allies target that enemy with abilities during this round, the last ally to do this gains a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the round and gains +4 ACC and +2 DMG on the ability if it was an attack.

#### >> Aegis Order — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Target up to 3 allies and another creature. Each ally who interacts with the chosen creature using an ability or ends their turn in their A gives them +3 EVA for 1 turn.

#### >>> />> Violent Verse — *Channeled Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Instrument*
**5/2 SN**  
**Effect:** Enemies suffer DMG while inside of specific ranges from you: A-C: 5 DMG M: 3 DMG L: 1 DMG

#### >>> />> Hymn of Hope — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Instrument*
**5/2 SN**  
**Effect:** Allies heal 5 SN when this ability is first used or 2 SN on subsequent turns while it remains channeled if they are inside of your M.

#### | Gamble — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Your Leadership orders this turn provide double bonuses, but those who follow them suffer -4 EVA while under their effects unless they spend a destiny point.

#### > Tactical Mastery — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**8 SN**  
**Effect:** You may perform a second Leadership order this turn at 0 ACP cost. It must target the same allies and they must achieve the conditions for both orders to get their benefits.

#### | Cacophony — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Instrument*
**10 SN**  
**Effect:** Activate all of your active channeled abilities that use an instrument at once for a single turn. Stop channeling all abilities at the end of your turn.

#### > /> Ode to The Observer — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Instrument*
**4/6 SN**  
**Effect:** You and allies within your M gain 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until your next turn.

sections.title: Shadow
sections.content:
# Shadow

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 153-156 -->  
**Strike from the shadows, win by any means.**  
*Recommended for assassins, cutthroats and shady gadgeteers.*  

## Abilities

#### > Weakpoint Jab — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Stealth*
**0 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Pierce 1.

#### > Bump in The Dark — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Stealth*
**0 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +3 DMG and inflicts Pierce 2 against Unaware targets.

#### >> Hunker Down — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 Strain** · +1 EVA  
**Effect:** If no enemy targets you until your next turn, you enter Stealth.

#### > Ambush Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Stealth*
**0 Strain** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +3 ACC and +3 DMG against Unaware targets.

#### >> Lunge — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Stealth*
**2 Strain** · -4 ACC · +3 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +4 ACC and inflicts Pierce 3 against Flanked and Unaware targets.

#### > Insidious Plot — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 Strain**  
**Effect:** Your next attack that uses Stealth weapons gains +2 ACC and +2 DMG

#### >> Moment of Reprieve — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**0 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Only usable while in Stealth. Restore 4 SN if your current SN is higher than half of your SL.

#### >> Opportunistic Angle — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN** · -3 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +3 ACC and inflicts Stun 2 against Flanked and Unaware targets.

#### >> Sacrificial Stab — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Stealth*
**4 SN** · +4 ACC · +3 DMG  
**Effect:** You suffer -3 EVA against melee attacks until your next turn.

#### >> Lay to Rest — *1H Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +2 ACC and +10 DMG against Unaware targets. Only usable against targets who have entered combat this round.

#### < Familiar Tricks — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Triggers on you being afflicted by Stun. Reduce the level of that effect by 2.

#### > Entrenched Position — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +2 EVA against ranged attacks from a target you attacked with a ranged attack this turn.

#### >> Daylight Robbery — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Stealth*
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Disarm the target and equip their weapon in your offhand if possible (CL 10 Stance save). The Stance save’s CL is 13 if the target is Flanked or 16 if the target is Unaware.

#### > Veil of Violence — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Enter Stealth if all enemies who targeted you since your previous turn are incapacitated or dead.

#### > Grim Satisfaction — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**0 SN**  
**Effect:** Restore 3 SN if you have killed or incapacitated an enemy while in Stealth this turn.

#### > Hidden Talent — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** The next attack you perform this turn gains +4 ACC if it uses a weapon type other than Stealth and if you haven’t used that weapon type before during this combat encounter.

#### >> Follow-up Execution — *1H Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Stealth*
**6 SN** · -8 ACC · +10 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack gains +8 ACC and inflicts Pierce 4 against targets that are Flanked and have been successfully attacked by your allies since your last turn.

#### < Murderous Frenzy — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Triggers on you incapacitating or killing an enemy. Gain 2 ACP. You may repeat abilities this turn.

#### < Gone and Forgotten — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Triggers on enemy melee attack targeting you missing. You gain an additional movement and immediately use it. If you get out of the line of sight of all enemies, you enter Stealth.

#### >> Feign Death — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, the next time you are targeted by an enemy attack you collapse, appear incapacitated to other enemies and enter Stealth. Your next attack against a Flanked or Unaware enemy during your next turn gains +5 ACC and +5 DMG.

sections.title: Precision
sections.content:
# Precision

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 157-159 -->  
**Eliminate from afar, oversee the battlefield.**  
*Recommended for archers, gunners and all those looking to rain down volleys of projectiles upon their foes.*  

## Abilities

#### >> Snap Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** -

#### >> Steady Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +1 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** You cannot use this ability if you have moved this turn and you cannot move this turn after using this ability.

#### >> Pin Down — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**2 SN** · -1 ACC · -2 DMG  
**Effect:** The target cannot move during their next turn (CL 12 Stance save). Inflict Stun 1.

#### > Take Aim — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +2 ACC on your next ranged attack this turn.

#### > Swift Reload — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Reload or holster a ranged weapon. Your next ranged attack gains +1 ACC.

#### >> Center of Mass — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Rifles, Pistol*
**3 SN** · +1 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Break 1.

#### >> Gut Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Bows, Stealth*
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · -1 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Bleeding 2.

#### >>> Point Blank Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Rifles, Pistol*
**4 SN** · -4 ACC · +10 DMG  
**Effect:** Must be performed at A range. Gains +4 ACC if the target is stunned.

#### >> Deadeye — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**3 SN** · -2 ACC · +4 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Pierce 1.

#### >> Disarming Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**4 SN** · -2 ACC · -2 DMG  
**Effect:** Disarm the target (CL 14 Stance save).

#### >> />> Suppressing Fire — *Channeled Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**1/1 SN** · +2 ACC · -3 DMG  
**Effect:** The target suffers -2 EVA and -2 on all rolls until your next turn.

#### >> Perfect Alignment — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**0 SN** · +2 EVA  
**Effect:** Your next ranged attack until the end of your next turn gains +2 ACC, inflicts Pierce 1 and restores 4 SN if you have more than half of your SL.

#### >> Trickshot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Rifles, Pistol*
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · -1 DMG  
**Effect:** Take a ricochet shot that ignores the target’s cover (the shot still must be theoretically possible). Inflict Pierce 2.

#### >>> Double Tap — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Pistol, Stealth*
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Repeat this attack once.

#### < Last Line — *Melee Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Bows, Rifles*
**4 SN** · +1 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Triggers on an enemy entering your A range.

#### >> Clutch Shot — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN** · +15 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** This attack may not be used more than once per combat encounter. This attack may not inflict additional DMG from ACC overflow.

#### >>> Fan Fire — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Pistol, Stealth*
**6 SN** · -1 ACC · +1 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Stun 1. Repeat this attack twice.

#### >>> Rapid Fire — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Rifles*
**6 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Pierce 1 and Break 1. This attack repeats once.

#### >>> Skewer — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Bows*
**6 SN** · +0 ACC · -2 DMG  
**Effect:** Inflict Bleeding 2. Repeat this attack twice on the same target.

#### >>> Seeking Missile — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Bows*
**1 SN** · +0 ACC · -1 DMG  
**Effect:** Whenever you perform this attack it gains +2 DMG and inflicts Pierce 1 the next time you use it during your next turn. This bonus stacks and refreshes with each use and is lost when the target is incapacitated or killed.

sections.title: Echo
sections.content:
# Echo

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 160-163 -->  
**Exploit the past, animate constructs.**  
*Recommended for explorers of memory shards, roboticists and ambedo experts.*  

## Abilities

#### >>> Past Insight — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Delve into an available static memory and re-experience it.

#### > Mind Glimpse — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Take a short peek at the target’s current thoughts. The target becomes Analyzed.

#### > Construct Command — *Utility Command*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with a Movement action or 2 AP.

#### >> Undivided Attention — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with a Movement action or 2 ACP.

#### >>> Archive Review — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +2 on your next INT roll outside of combat. This effect persists for 10 minutes and doesn’t stack.

#### >> Frequency Shift — *Utility Action*
*Requires: Class Rank 1 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Gain +2 on all rolls during your next memory delve. Lasts for 10 minutes and does not stack.

#### | Evasion Protocol — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with +2 EVA until your next turn.

#### | Harm Protocol — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with +2 DMG until your next turn.

#### >>> Memory Intrusion — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**6 SN**  
**Effect:** Forcefully analyze a target’s memory that you are aware of (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Willpower save).

#### >> Reality Tether — *Utility Action*
*Requires: Class Rank 2 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Roll all saving throws during your next memory delve with advantage. Lasts for 10 minutes.

#### > Destruction Command — *Utility Command*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with +2 ACP, +1 DMG dealt and +1 to all status effects inflicted until your next turn. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### > Relocation Command — *Utility Command*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with 2 movement actions. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### >>> Silent Intrusion — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**8 SN**  
**Effect:** Secretly analyze a target’s memory that you are aware of (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Perception save). The ability fails and the target becomes aware of the attempt upon failure.

#### >> Assistive Link — *Utility Action*
*Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**1 SN**  
**Effect:** Use your eidoloscope to mentally tether to a willing creature. Both of you may use the skill scores of the other for rolling any non-combat roll at the cost of 5 SN. Lasts for 10 minutes.

#### | Mutual Destruction — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, whenever a construct you are paired with inflicts DMG to an enemy it may deplete up to that much of its armour points and inflict that much break to the enemy. It may also deplete its VG in order to add that much DMG to the next attack that turn. Make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### | / | Purify Signal — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**1/2 SN**  
**Effect:** Give a construct you are paired with +2 ACC. It can not inflict additional DMG from ACC overflow while this ability is being channeled. Upon casting, make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### >>> Memory Insertion — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**12 SN**  
**Effect:** Secretly alter a target’s memory that you have delved into or implant an entirely manufactured one (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Perception save). If the ability fails the target becomes aware of the attempt.

#### >>> Ambedic Imprint — *Utility Action*
*Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Eidoloscope*
**10 SN**  
**Effect:** Record and imprint the memory you are currently inside of onto an empty ambedic shard.

#### | Consciousness Exertion — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Until your next turn, you may perform abilities that grant AP to your linked constructs at no AP cost but at 3 Strain cost per AP granted. Make a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

#### | Perceptive Anomaly — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Fuse your mind with your linked construct completely, redirecting effects that would affect it to yourself. Until your next turn, all DMG and status effects that construct would suffer are redirected to you instead. You gain a temporary destiny point for each ability you redirect to yourself this way.

The ability fails and the target becomes aware of the attempt upon failure. Assistive Link — Utility Action Requires: Class Rank 3 · Weapons: Eidoloscope 1 SN Effect: Use your eidoloscope to mentally tether to a willing creature. Both of you may use the skill scores of the other for rolling any non-combat roll at the cost of 5 SN. Lasts for 10 minutes. Mutual Destruction — Utility Requires: Class Rank 3 2 SN Effect: Until your next turn, whenever a construct you are paired with inflicts DMG to an enemy it may deplete up to that much of its armour points and inflict that much break to the enemy. It may also deplete its VG in order to add that much DMG to the next attack that turn. Make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch. / Purify Signal — Utility Requires: Class Rank 3 1/2 SN Effect: Give a construct you are paired with +2 ACC. It can not inflict additional DMG from ACC overflow while this ability is being channeled. Upon casting, make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch. Memory Insertion — Utility Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Eidoloscope 12 SN Effect: Secretly alter a target’s memory that you have delved into or implant an entirely manufactured one (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Perception save). If the ability fails the target becomes aware of the attempt. Ambedic Imprint — Utility Action Requires: Class Rank 4 · Weapons: Eidoloscope 10 SN Effect: Record and imprint the memory you are currently inside of onto an empty ambedic shard. Consciousness Exertion — Utility Requires: Class Rank 4 2 SN Effect: Until your next turn, you may perform abilities that grant AP to your linked constructs at no AP cost but at 3 Strain cost per AP granted. Make a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch. Perceptive Anomaly — Utility Requires: Class Rank 4 4 SN Effect: Fuse your mind with your linked construct completely, redirecting effects that would affect it to yourself. Until your next turn, all DMG and status effects that construct would suffer are redirected to you instead. You gain a temporary destiny point for each ability you redirect to yourself this way.

sections.title: Zeal
sections.content:
# Zeal

<!-- chapter: 06-disciplines | pages: 164-168 -->  
**Profess your convictions, evoke your Season.**  
*Recommended for zealous paragons, powerful sorcerers and all those looking to enact their Season upon the world.*  

## Abilities

#### >> Vital Attunement — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice You add a target creature to your network of Attunement and heal SN equal to the number of creatures you are attuned to if your SN is higher than or equal to half of your SL, rounded down. You remain attuned to the creature for up to 1 hour.

#### >> Warp Flesh — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice Inflict Bleeding 1. If targeting an armored target, all other effects and DMG of the attack are negated and it inflicts Break 1 instead. Requires Attunement.

#### >> Wither — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice Inflict Feeble 2 and Stun 1. Requires Attunement.

#### >>> Realign Biomass — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice Target yourself or someone you can physically touch and are Attuned to. The target heals 2d6 HP and is cleansed of Bleeding. They suffer Stun 1.

#### >>> Bodily Sculpting — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**20 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Halice Create a new body part of any shape which may be attached to a living creature or reshape an existing body part. Requires sufficient compatible biomass to function. For example, a human arm made of leaves would not be able to sustain itself while attached to a human, something more adjacent like animal flesh would be required. Similarly, rotten or diseased flesh would likely cause a lot of harm should it be reshaped into an organ and attached to a living creature.

#### >> Scorch — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · -1 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Suffer Soulburn 1. Inflict Burn 2.

#### >> Flame Pylon — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**4 SN** · +0 ACC · 0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Suffer Soulburn 1. A burning target and all enemies within its A suffer Burn equal to your Soulburn.

#### >> Extinguish — *Defensive*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**3 Strain** · +0 EVA  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor Fully cleanse your Soulburn and gain +EVA equal to its rank until your next turn.

#### >> Virulent Combustion — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**5 SN** · +0 ACC · +0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor This attack can chain to enemies within C, including those it has already hit. The number of times it can chain is limited to your soulburn rank. Inflict Burn 2.

#### >> />>> Heartburn — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**5/2 SN** · -4 ACC · 0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Vamor This attack gains +4 ACC on burning targets. Every turn that this attack is channeled, you suffer Soulburn 1 and you inflict Burn equal to your soulburn rank on your target. If the attack is successful on the initial cast, it will continue to successfully hit on the following turns regardless of rolls. Damage that would be inflicted through ACC overflow is instead converted to additional Burn.

#### >> Ghostly Flicker — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma This ability inflicts SN instead of DMG. If SN would go over the target’s SL the ability also deals equal DMG and inflicts Stun 2.

#### >> Disrupt Mind — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**2 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma The target cannot repeat any actions they used during their previous turn (CL 14 Willpower save). Inflict Stun 3.

#### >> Asylum — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**0 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Heal any amount of SN from allies within your M. You suffer that much SN divided by 2 and rounded down.

#### >> Eclipse — *Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**4 SN**  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma Temporarily suppress the consciousness of a creature strongly enough it disappears from reality for one combat round. Only usable on creatures with half or more of their SL who were not targeted by this ability last round.

#### >> /> Void Anchor — *Channeled Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**4/2 SN** · +0 ACC  
**Effect:** Conviction: Bruma This ability inflicts SN instead of DMG. If SN would go over the target’s SL the ability also deals equal DMG and inflicts Stun 1. Suppress consciousness in a M radius around you. Perform as a regular attack upon using the ability. While channeled on later turns, the ability acts as an aura that inflicts 3 SN to your enemies within its range for every round they spend within it.

#### >> Compress Matter — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 0*
**0 SN** · +0 ACC · 0 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst Move your Mass Origin (MO) to the location of your target and Inflict Break 1. If the MO is already on your target, this attack inflicts DMG.

#### >> Lockdown — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 1*
**3 SN** · +0 ACC · 2 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst If your MO is on the target, they are unable to move until your next turn and suffer Stun 2. Otherwise, this ability costs 1 ACP and you move your MO onto the target and have it follow them until your next turn.

#### >> Repulse — *Melee/Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 2*
**6 SN** · +0 ACC · 2 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst Inflict Push 2 in any direction on all targets within C of your MO. The targets suffer Stun 2 and 1 DMG that ignores armour if they would hit something or are instead knocked Prone (Cl 12 Stance save) if they end up in an empty space.

#### >> /> Spatial Anomaly — *Channeled Utility*
*Requires: Class Rank 3*
**3/2 SN** · +0 ACC  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst You may move your MO to a place you can see within your M upon casting this ability. Inflict Stun 1 and Pull 1 towards your MO on all enemies within C of it every turn this ability remains channeled.

#### >>> Pressure Absolute — *Ranged Attack*
*Requires: Class Rank 4*
**2 SN** · +0 ACC · +2 DMG  
**Effect:** Conviction: Trumst May target any number of targets within M for +2 SN for each target beyond the first. For each target choose Lift or Bend. They are affected by this ability until your next turn. Your MO disappears after performing this ability. Lift: The enemy is lifted a single tile above ground and held in place, suffering -5 EVA. Inflict Stun 2. Bend: The enemy is crushed by pressure from above and held in place Prone. Inflict Break 2.
